quote: May flowers grow in the saddest parts of you.
author: Zainab Aamir

quote: Perhaps we were friends first and lovers second. But then perhaps this is what lovers are.
author: André Aciman

quote: The summer I’d hear a bird sing, smell a plant, or feel the mist rise from under my feet on warm sunny days and, because my senses were always on alert, would automatically find them rushing to him.
author: André Aciman

quote: There is a theory which states that if ever anyone discovers exactly what the Universe is for and why it is here, it will instantly disappear and be replaced by something even more bizarre and inexplicable. There is another theory which states that this has already happened.
author: Douglas Adams
source: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe, 1980

quote: He felt a vague, inexplicable nostalgia for what had not happened, and the lessons it might have taught him.
author: César Aira
source: An Episode in the Life of a Landscape Painter, 2000

quote: I don’t speak with anyone for a week. I just sit on a stone by the sea.
author: Anna Akhmatova

quote: In order to move on, you must understand why you felt what you did and why you no longer need to feel it.
author: Mitch Albom
source: The Five People You Meet in Heaven, 2003

quote: Why are we embarrassed by silence? What comfort do we find in all the noise?
author: Mitch Albom

quote: Once you’ve taken a few punches and realize you’re not made of glass, you don’t feel alive unless you’re pushing yourself as far as you can go.
author: Lexi Alexander

quote: I think I fall in love a little bit with anyone who shows me their soul. This world is so guarded and fearful. I appreciate rawness so much.
author: Emery Allen

quote: Do you think the universe fights for souls to be together? Some things are too strange and strong to be coincidences.
author: Emery Allen

quote: To whom it may concern: Today, I am alive.
author: Zaina Alsous

quote: To burn the Witch is to admit that magic exists.
author: Erin Anastasia

quote:
The heart is a violent muscle; it opens & shuts.
The subject is death.
The subject is also laughter.
author: Jon Anderson

quote: I'm going to think about death until my mouth runs. I'm going to look at death with a face terrible as his own.
author: Jon Anderson

quote: I fell in love with the idea that the mysterious thing you look for your whole life will eventually eat you alive.
author: Laurie Anderson

quote: Rudeness is merely an expression of fear. People fear they won’t get what they want. The most dreadful and unattractive person only needs to be loved, and they will open up like a flower.
author: Wes Anderson

quote: I’m a little wounded, but I am not slain; I will lay me down to bleed a while. Then I’ll rise and fight again.
author: Anonymous
source: The Ballad of Johnnie Armstrong, as cited by J. Roberts in A Collection of Old Ballads: Corrected from the Best and Most Ancient Copies Extant (x)

quote: I'm such an incredibly, stupidly sensitive person that everything that happens to me, I experience it really intensely. I feel everything very deeply. And when you feel things deeply and you think about things a lot and you think about how you feel, you learn a lot about yourself. And when you know yourself, you know life.
author: Fiona Apple
source: in an interview for MTV News, October 4, 1996 (x)

quote: The head may err, but never the blood.
author: Nakajima Atsushi

quote: Not once have I regretted the things that I did. I only ever regret the things that I did not do. I want no regrets.
author: Nakajima Atsushi

quote: Murderess is a strong word to have attached to you. It has a smell to it, that word — musky and oppressive, like dead flowers in a vase. Sometimes at night I whisper it over to myself: Murderess, Murderess. It rustles, like a taffeta skirt across the floor.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: When I was younger I used to think that if I could hug myself tight enough I could make myself smaller, because there was never enough room for me, at home or anywhere, but if I was smaller than I would fit in.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote:
My shadow said to me:
What is the matter?
Isn’t the moon warm
enough for you?
Why do you need
the blanket of another body?
author: Margaret Atwood
source: The Animals in That Country, 1968: ‘The Shadow Voice’

quote: When you're young, you think everything you do is disposable. You move from now to now, crumpling time up in your hands, tossing it away. You're your own speeding car. You think you can get rid of things, and people too — leave them behind. You don't yet know about the habit they have, of coming back. Time in dreams is frozen. You can never get away from where you've been.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: She doesn’t want to reveal jealousy or even interest, though she suddenly realizes that she feels both.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: I avoid looking down at my body, not so much because it’s shameful or immodest but because I don’t want to see it. I don’t want to look at something that determines me so completely.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: ’This is the wrong place for me to be.‘ She doesn’t mean my house. She means her body.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: Because I was driven to it by some force outside my control. Because I was possessed. Because an angel dictated to me.
author: Margaret Atwood
source: Negotiating with the Dead: A Writer on Writing, 2002

quote: Water does not resist. Water flows. When you plunge your hand into it, all you feel is a caress. Water is not a solid wall, it will not stop you. But water always goes where it wants to go, and nothing in the end can stand against it. Water is patient. Dripping water wears away a stone. Remember that, my child. Remember you are half water. If you can’t go through an obstacle, go around it. Water does.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote:
Is it suffering or goodness
that makes them holy,
or can anyone tell the difference?
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: You are not my cure; nobody has that power.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: You would rather have gone on feeling nothing, emptiness and silence; the stagnant peace of the deepest sea, which is easier than the noise and flesh of the surface.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote:
How can I teach her
some way of being human
that won't destroy her?
I would like to tell her, Love
is enough, I would like to say,
Find shelter in another skin.
I would like to say, Dance
and be happy. Instead I will say
in my crone's voice, Be
ruthless when you have to, tell
the truth when you can,
when you can see it.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: The desire to be loved is the last illusion: Give it up and you will be free.
author: Margaret Atwood
Margaret Atwood

quote: Whose life am I living? Whose life am I failing to live?
author: Margaret Atwood

quote:
Last year I abstained
this year I devour
without guilt
which is also an art.
author: Margaret Atwood

quote: Watch the course of the stars, as if you are running with them. Always keep in mind how the elements change into one another. The thoughts of these things will wash away the dirt of life.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: If I loved you less, I might be able to talk about it more. But you know what I am.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I was quiet, but I was not blind.
author: Jane Austen

quote: There is nothing I would not do for those who are really my friends. I have no notion of loving people by halves, it is not my nature.
author: Jane Austen

quote: Each found her greatest safety in silence.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I have been a selfish being all my life, in practice, though not in principle.
author: Jane Austen

quote: What are men to rocks and mountains?
author: Jane Austen

quote: We do not suffer by accident.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I can never fight for myself, but, for others, I can kill.
author: Emilie Autumn

quote: It doesn’t matter how many relationships we seem to have. We’re all alone.
author: Yukito Ayatsuji

quote: If you will practice being fictional for a while, you will understand that fictional characters are sometimes more real than people with bodies and heartbeats.
author: Richard Bach
source: Illusions: The Adventures of a Reluctant Messiah, 1977

quote: You read something which you thought only happened to you, and you discover that it happened 100 years ago to Dostoyevsky. This is a very great liberation for the suffering, struggling person, who always thinks that he is alone. This is why art is important. Art would not be important if life were not important, and life is important.
author: James Baldwin

quote: When one begins to search for the crucial, the definitive moment, the moment which changed all others, one finds oneself pressing, in great pain, through a maze of false signals and abruptly locked doors.
author: James Baldwin

quote: Some day you will find out that there is far more happiness in another’s happiness than in your own.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: People say ‘phase’ like impermanence means insignificance. Show me a permanent state of the self.
author: Alixandra Bamford

quote: I hope that someday, somebody wants to hold you for twenty minutes straight, and that’s all they do. They don’t pull away. They don’t look at your face. They don’t try to kiss you. All they do is wrap you up in their arms, without an ounce of selfishness in it.
author: Sara Bareilles

quote: I am not young enough to know everything.
author: J.M. Barrie

quote: Don’t ever put your happiness in someone else’s hands. They’ll drop it. They’ll drop it every time.
author: Christopher Barzak

quote: One should always be drunk. That’s all that matters… But with what? With wine, with poetry, or with virtue, as you choose. But get drunk.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: Do not search for my heart anymore; the beasts have eaten it.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote:
I am the wound, and yet the blade!
The smack, and yet the cheek that takes it!
The limb, and yet the wheel that breaks it,
The torturer, and he who's flayed!
author: Charles Baudelaire
source: Les Fleurs du Mal, 1857: Heautontimoroumenos, translated by Roy Campbell

quote: Almost. It’s a big word for me. I feel it everywhere. Almost home. Almost happy. Almost changed. Almost, but not quite. Not yet. Soon, maybe.
author: John Bauer

quote: On the day when it will be possible for woman to love not in her weakness but in her strength, not to escape herself but to find herself, not to abase herself but to assert herself — on that day love will become for her, as for man, a source of life and not of mortal danger.
author: Simone de Beauvoir

quote:
Our tears are sweet, our laughter venomous.
We’re pleased when sad, and sad when pleased.
We wash one hand in blood, the other we wash the blood off.
We cry as we laugh at the futility of both these acts.
author: Simin Behbahani

quote: Once, I kissed someone and I’m afraid it ruined the world. I’ve learned it’s not what you do with the knife — it’s how you hold it after. But how do you hold something like that? Something that never stops baring its teeth; a voiceless dog, all bite, no bark.
author: Yasmin Belkhyr

quote: The gods envy us. They envy us because we’re mortal, because any moment may be our last. Everything is more beautiful because we are doomed. You will never be lovelier than you are now. We will never be here again.
author: David Benioff

quote: What’s the worst thing I’ve stolen? Probably little pieces of other people’s lives. Where I’ve either wasted their time or hurt them in some way. That’s the worst thing you can steal, the time of other people. You just can’t get that back.
author: Chester Bennington

quote: Remember that despair and joy are not incompatible. Despair is a consequence of understanding. Joy is a condition of the emotional mind. Despair is to acknowledge the truth of the present situation, but the sceptical mind knows that the only truth is shared imagination and shared projection. So do not be frightened by despair. It does not delimit the potential for joy. And joy is a condition for proving intellectual despair wrong.
author: Franco Berardi

quote: One should hate very little, because it’s extremely fatiguing. One should despise much, forgive often, and never forget. Pardon does not bring with it forgetfulness; at least not for me.
author: Sarah Bernhardt

quote: Why hurt someone whose only intention was to love you?
author: Reyna Biddy

quote: Soon you'll realize that many people will love the idea of you but will lack the maturity to handle the reality of you.
author: Reyna Biddy

quote: EDIBLE, adj. Good to eat, and wholesome to digest, as a worm to a toad, a toad to a snake, a snake to a pig, a pig to a man, and a man to a worm.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: This is mine. This sequence of evicted possibilities. Displaced facts. Tricks of light. Reflections. Invention, legend, myth. What you will. The shifts and fluencies are infinite. The moving parts are marvelous.
author: Eavan Boland
source: An Origin Like Water: Collected Poems 1957-1987, ‘Listen. This Is the Noise of Myth’

quote: She is not myself anymore she is not even in my sky anymore and I am not myself.
author: Eaven Boland

quote: So you plant your own garden and decorate your own soul, instead of waiting for someone to bring you flowers.
author: Jorge Luis Borges

quote: I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.
author: Jorge Luis Borges

quote: Time forks perpetually toward innumerable futures. In one of them I am your enemy.
author: Jorge Luis Borges

quote: Most of our childhood is stored not in photos, but in certain biscuits, lights of day, smells, textures of carpet.
author: Alain de Botton

quote: Intimacy is the capacity to be rather weird with someone - and finding that that’s ok with them.
author: Alain de Botton

quote:
The Night has a thousand eyes,
And the Day but one;
Yet the light of the bright world dies
With the dying sun.
The mind has a thousand eyes,
And the heart but one;
Yet the light of a whole life dies
When love is done.
author: Francis William Bourdillon

quote: You are born alone. You die alone. The value of the space in between is trust and love. That is why geometrically speaking the circle is a one. Everything comes to you from the other. You have to be able to reach the other.
author: Louise Bourgeois
source: Destruction of the Father / Reconstruction of the Father: Writings and Interviews, 1923-1997

quote: I just want someone to hear what I have to say. And maybe if I talk long enough, it’ll make sense.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: How do you get so empty? Who takes it out of you?
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: Perhaps you stared into a river. There was somebody near you who loved you. They were about to touch you. You could feel this before it happened. Then it happened. That is my name.
author: Richard Brautigan

quote: Every child finds a day when they realize that adults can be weak and wrong just like everyone else. After that day, you are an adult. Like it or not.
author: Peter V. Brett

quote: Ghost me. Fossil me. Resurrect me near dawn.
author: Traci Brimhall
source: Our Lady of the Ruins, ‘Become the Lion’

quote: He is not of their kind. I believe he is of mine; I am sure he is, I feel akin to him, I understand the language of his countenance and movements… I have something in my brain and heart, in my blood and nerves, that assimilates me mentally to him.
author: Charlotte Brontë

quote: Crying does not indicate that you are weak. Since birth, it has always been a sign that you are alive.
author: Charlotte Brontë

quote: Half thinking, half dreaming, happier than words can express.
author: Emily Brontë

quote: You say I killed you — haunt me, then!
author: Emily Brontë

quote: You say ‘amateur’ as if it was a dirty word. ‘Amateur’ comes from the Latin word ‘amare’, which means to love. To do things for the love of it.
author: Adam Brooks
source: Mozart in the Jungle, 2014-2018: ‘It All Depends on You’

quote: It’s okay to say to people in your life, ‘I need you to love me a little louder today.’
author: Karamo Brown

quote: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
author: Les Brown

quote: Did you ever feel afraid of your own soul, as I have done?
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning
source: in a letter to Robert Browning

quote: Sometimes it feels good to take the long way home.
author: Carol Rifka Brunt

quote: One faces the future with one’s past.
author: Pearl S. Buck

quote: They may forget what you said — but they will never forget how you made them feel.
author: Carl W. Buehner
source: as cited by Richard Evans in Richard Evans' Quote Book, 1971

quote: We don’t even ask for happiness, just a little less pain.
author: Charles Bukowski
source: in a letter to William Packard

quote: We’re all going to die, all of us, what a circus! That alone should make us love each other but it doesn’t. We are terrorized and flattened by trivialities, we are eaten up by nothing.
author: Charles Bukowski
source: The Captain is Out to Lunch and the Sailors have taken over the Ship

quote: You have to die a few times before you can really live.
author: Charles Bukowski
source: The People Look Like Flowers At Last: New Poems

quote: How can you say you love one person when there are ten thousand people in the world that you would love more if you ever met them? But you’ll never meet them. All right, so we do the best we can. Granted. But we must still realize that love is just the result of a chance encounter.
author: Charles Bukowski

quote: My heart expands in celestial songs.
author: Julia de Burgos
source: Song of the Simple Truth, ‘Dream of Words’

quote: I myself am made entirely of flaws, stitched together with good intentions.
author: Augusten Burroughs

quote: The human mind is not a terribly logical or consistent place.
author: Jim Butcher

quote: But I have been familiar with ruins too long to dislike desolation.
author: George Gordon Byron
source: in a letter to Thomas Moore

quote: If I do not write to empty my mind, I go mad.
author: George Gordon Byron

quote: It made me wonder how many times we forgive just because we don’t want to lose someone, even if they don’t deserve our forgiveness.
author: Deb Caletti

quote: Life has no meaning. Each of us has meaning and we bring it to life. It is a waste to be asking the question when you are the answer.
author: Joseph Campbell

quote: Overflow gently — don’t drown.
author: Albert Camus

quote: He encouraged me; I shall never forget some of the things he said. He told me life isn’t easy, but it has consolations: religion, art, and the love one inspires in others. He often told me that the only mistake one makes in life is to cause others suffering.
author: Albert Camus

quote: I can feel this heart inside me and I conclude it exists. I can touch this world and I also conclude that it exists. All my knowledge ends at this point. The rest is hypothesis.
author: Albert Camus

quote: If you can’t sleep, then get up and do something instead of lying there and worrying. It’s the worry that gets you, not the loss of sleep.
author: Dale Carnegie
source: How to Win Friends and Influence People

quote: Alice asked the Cheshire Cat, who was sitting in a tree, ‘What road do I take?’ The cat asked, ‘Where do you want to go?’ ‘I don’t know,’ Alice answered. ‘Then,’ said the cat, ‘it really doesn’t matter, does it?’
author: Lewis Carroll

quote: I knew who I was this morning, but I’ve change a few times since then.
author: Lewis Carroll

quote: A burning brightness brightens and is lost.
author: Hayden Carruth
source: Scrambled Eggs & Whiskey: Poems, 1991-1995; ‘They Accuse Me of not Talking’

quote: ‘You remember too much,’ my mother said to me recently. ‘Why hold onto all that?’ And I said, ‘Where can I put it down?’
author: Anne Carson

quote: Beauty makes me hopeless. I don’t care why anymore I just want to get away. When I look at the city of Paris I long to wrap my legs around it. When I watch you dancing there is a heartless immensity like a sailor in a dead calm sea. Desires as round as peaches bloom in me all night, I no longer gather what falls.
author: Anne Carson

quote: The day broke around me like a cool dream. Sea; sand; a sky that melts into the sea — a landscape of misty pastels with a look about it being continuously on the point of melting.
author: Angela Carter

quote: I feared a wound not of the body but the soul, an irreconcilable division between myself and the rest of humankind. I feared the proof of my own singularity.
author: Angela Carter

quote: No matter how many people care about you, if you can’t be open with them about who you truly are, you’re still alone.
author: Diane Chamberlain

quote: The truth of the story: after us, there will be another, then another, then another.
author: Marianne Chan

quote: Godhood is just like girlhood: a begging to be believed.
author: Kristin Chang

quote: I’ve polished this anger and now it’s a knife.
author: Cathy Linh Che

quote: Don’t tell me the moon is shining; show me the glint of light on broken glass.
author: Anton Chekhov
source: in a letter to Alexander Chekhov

quote: Her blood is dancing, she wants to live, and there is no life here.
author: Anton Chekhov

quote: I kept wishing I could just pluck out my heart, because it had become so heavy.
author: Anton Chekhov

quote: Courage is almost a contradiction in terms. It means a strong desire to live taking the form of a readiness to die.
author: G.K. Chesterton

quote: He opened his mouth to say that he knew exactly what she meant, that he had felt the same things as she. But he stopped himself: for this was an empathy that separated rather than united them, and he couldn’t tell her that.
author: Ted Chiang

quote: God is not just, God is not kind, God is not merciful, and understanding that is essential to true devotion.
author: Ted Chiang

quote: My message to you is this: pretend that you have free will. It’s essential that you behave as if your decisions matter, even though you know they don’t. The reality isn’t important: what’s important is your belief, and believing the lie is the only way to avoid a waking coma. Civilization now depends on self-deception. Perhaps it always has.
author: Ted Chiang

quote: What if the experience of knowing the future changed a person? What if it evoked a sense of urgency, a sense of obligation to act precisely as she knew she would?
author: Ted Chiang

quote: We live on the road to heaven; all the work that we do is to extend it further.
author: Ted Chiang

quote: Pragmatism avails a savior far more than aestheticism.
author: Ted Chiang

quote: Be kinder to yourself. And then let your kindness flood the world.
author: Pema Chödrön

quote: I wish I could throw off the thoughts which poison my happiness. And yet I take a kind of pleasure in indulging them.
author: Frédéric Chopin
source: as quoted by Arthur Hedley in Chopin

quote: Emptiness is a blessing: it can’t be owned if it doesn’t exist.
author: Lisa Ciccarello

quote: The truth has a strange way of following you, of coming up to you and making you listen to what it has to say.
author: Sandra Cisneros

quote: You only have to look at the Medusa straight on to see her. And she’s not deadly. She’s beautiful and she’s laughing.
author: Hélène Cixous

quote: People do not see you; they invent you and accuse you.
author: Hélène Cixous

quote: One must be careful of books, and what is inside them, for words have the power to change us.
author: Cassandra Clare

quote: He smiled the way Lucifer might have smiled, moments before he fell from Heaven.
author: Cassandra Clare

quote:
So dull and dark are the November days.
The lazy mist high up the evening curled,
And now the morn quite hides in smoke and haze;
The place we occupy seems all the world.
author: John Clare

quote: I think it’s important to realize you can miss something, but not want it back.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: Scars speak more loudly than the sword that caused them.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: There is a crack in everything. That’s how the light gets in.
author: Leonard Cohen

quote: And it’s amazing how much noise people ignoring each other can make.
author: Eoin Colfer

quote: Do you still perform autopsies on conversations you had lives ago?
author: Donte Collins

quote: The more you know who you are, and what you want, the less you let things upset you.
author: Sofia Coppola

quote: Even though I had a lot left to say to you, I’d rather choke on my words in silence, then allow you to see me in any state of vulnerability.
author: Kirsten Corley

quote: Someone asked me what home was and all I could think of were the stars on the tip of your tongue, the flowers sprouting from your mouth, the roots entwined in the gaps between your fingers, the ocean echoing inside of your ribcage.
author: Elizabeth Corn

quote: Thank you for letting me find my role; to comfort the disturbed and disturb the comfortable.
author: César A. Cruz
source: Revenge of the Illegal Alien: A Mexican Takes on the Empire

quote: Dreams speak within us what no word is capable of saying.
author: Mia Couto
source: ‘Languages We Don’t Know We Know,’ 2008, translated by David Brookshaw

quote: One day I will tell you what I’ve been. It will scare you.
author: Yrsa Daley-Ward

quote:
In the world I am
Always a stranger
I do not understand its language
It does not understand my silence.
author: Bei Dao

quote: Peace to the hint of sadness in your eyes.
author: Mahmoud Darwish

quote:
I loved you head over handles
like my first bicycle accident—
before the mouthful of gravel and blood,
I swore we were flying.
author: Sierra DeMulder

quote:
‘Look,’ he said, ‘the point is there’s no way to be a hundred percent sure about anyone or anything. So you’re left with a choice. Either hope for the best or expect the worst.’
‘If you expect the worst, you’re never disappointed,’ I pointed out. ‘Yeah, but who lives like that?’
author: Sarah Dessen

quote: Holding people away from you, and denying yourself love, that doesn’t make you strong. If anything, it makes you weaker. Because you’re doing it out of fear.
author: Sarah Dessen

quote: I like flaws. I think they make things interesting.
author: Sarah Dessen

quote:
This is my knee, since she touches me there.
This is my throat, as defined by her reaching.
I am touched—I am.
author: Natalie Diaz
source: Isn't the Air Also a Body, Moving?, 2017

quote: I wish you a kinder sea.
author: Emily Dickinson
source: in a letter to Catherine May Scott c. August 1848

quote: And I am out with lanterns, looking for myself.
author: Emily Dickinson
source: in a letter to Elizabeth Holland c. 20 January 1856 (x)

quote: The ocean’s heart too smooth, too blue, to break for you.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote:
At least I have the flowers of myself,
and my thoughts, no god
can take that.
author: Hilda Doolittle

quote: So if you love me, love me everywhere.
author: Hilda Doolittle

quote: Right now I want a word that describes the feeling you get — a cold, sick feeling deep down inside — when you know something is happening that will change you, and you don’t want it to, but you can’t stop it. And you know, for the first time, for the very first time, that there will now be a before and an after, a was and a will be. And that you will never again be quite the person you were.
author: Jennifer Donnelly

quote: ‘I exist.’ In thousands of agonies — I exist. I’m tormented on the rack — but I exist! Though I sit alone in a pillar — I exist! I see the sun, and if I don’t see the sun, I know it’s there. And there’s a whole life in that, in knowing that the sun is there.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quote: Which is better: cheap happiness or sublime suffering?
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quote: I create entire romances in my dreams.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quote: If the sight of the blue skies fills you with joy, if a blade of grass springing up in the fields has power to move you, if the simple things in nature have a message you understand, rejoice, for your soul is alive.
author: Eleonora Duse
source: as quoted by Toby Cole and Helen Krich in Actors on Acting, 1970

quote: When you judge another, you do not define them, you define yourself.
author: Wayne Dyer

quote: With every drop you drink, every breath you take, you’re connected to the sea.
author: Sylvia Earle
source: as cited by the National Aquarium (x)

quote: Beauty is, in some way, boring. Even if its concept changes through the ages… a beautiful object must always follow certain rules. A beautiful nose shouldn’t be longer than that or shorter than that, on the contrary, an ugly nose can be as long as the one of Pinocchio, or as big as the trunk of an elephant, or like the beak of an eagle, and so ugliness is unpredictable, and offers an infinite range of possibility. Beauty is finite, ugliness is infinite like God.
author: Umberto Eco

quote: I have a very childlike rage, and a very childlike loneliness.
author: Richey Edwards

quote: The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: If there is magic on this planet, it is contained in water.
author: Loren Eiseley

quote: The sea has many voices. Many Gods and many voices.
author: T.S. Eliot

quote: In my end is my beginning.
author: T.S. Eliot

quote:
This is the way the world ends
This is the way the world ends
This is the way the world ends
Not with a bang but a whimper.
author: T.S. Eliot

quote: Are you alive or not? Is there nothing in your head?
author: T.S. Eliot

quote: Is evil something you are, or something you do?
author: Bret Easton Ellis

quote: People also smile when they are miserable.
author: Paul Ekman
source: Telling Lies: Clues to Deceit in the Marketplace, Politics, and Marriage

quote: There is within all of us something that is too fragile not to break, too fragile or too inexpedient.
author: Rabbe Enckell

quote:
Memory eats me alive.
Memory guts me,
unravels me, strews me
in the snow.
author: Aurora Engle-Pratt

quote: If you inherently long for something, become it first. If you want gardens, become the gardener. If you want love, embody love. If you want mental stimulation, change the conversation. If you want peace, exude calmness. If you want to fill your world with artists, begin to paint. If you want to be valued, respect your own time. If you want to live ecstatically, find the ecstasy within yourself. This is how to draw it in, day by day, inch by inch.
author: Victoria Erickson

quote: Millions long for immortality who don’t know what to do with themselves on a rainy Sunday afternoon.
author: Susan Ertz

quote: I am overflowing with words I do not have.
author: Adam Falkner

quote: Oh God, my God, what have I done, in that place of secluded dark silence?
author: Forough Farrokhzad

quote: I have cried an ocean for you but still your ship refuses to sail.
author: Michael Faudet

quote: You cannot remove my scars or rewrite the past that haunts me. Just hold me tight and tell me everything is going to be okay.
author: Michael Faudet

quote: Science is a way of trying not to fool yourself. The first principle is that you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
author: Richard Feynman

quote: Sleep heavily and know that I am here with you now. The past is gone, and cannot harm you anymore. And while the future is fast coming for you, it always flinches first, and settles in as the gentle present. This now, this us, we can cope with that. We can do this together, you and I. Drowsily, but comfortably.
author: Joseph Fink and Jeffrey Cranor

quote: I can’t exactly describe how I feel but it’s not quite right. And it leaves me cold.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quote: Well, let it pass; April is over, April is over. There are all kinds of love in the world, but never the same love twice.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quote: And in the end, we are all just humans… drunk on the idea that love, only love, can heal our brokenness.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quote: What is there to say? You know how much I have loved you.
author: Zelda Fitzgerald
source: in a letter to F. Scott Fitzgerald, February 1935

quote: You are a curious case of strangeness and extraordinary loveliness.
author: Gustave Flaubert
source: in a letter to George Sand, c. November 1870

quote: She wanted to die, but she also wanted to live in Paris.
author: Gustave Flaubert

quote: The future was a dark corridor, and at the far end the door was bolted.
author: Gustave Flaubert

quote: ‘Ah!’ she said, lifting her lovely tear-bright eyes to the ceiling. ‘If you knew all the dreams I’ve dreamed!’
author: Gustave Flaubert

quote: A child weaned on poison considers harm a comfort.
author: Gillian Flynn

quote: I think and think and think, I’ve thought myself out of happiness one million times, but never once into it.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: ‘Why do beautiful songs make you sad?’ ‘Because they aren’t true.’ ‘Never?’ ‘Nothing is beautiful and true.’
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: Sometimes I can hear my bones straining under the weight of all the lives I’m not living.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: Shyness is when you turn your head away from something you want. Shame is when you turn your head away from something you do not want.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: I’m so afraid of losing something I love, that I refuse to love anything.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: When I am with him, smoking or talking quietly ahead, or whatever it may be, I see, beyond my own happiness and intimacy, occasional glimpses of the happiness of 1000s of others whose names I shall never hear, and know that there is a great unrecorded history.
author: E. M. Forster
source: Selected Letters of E. M. Forster I: 1879-1920, 1983

quote: I wear the universe backwards. I imagine putting stars in my coffee, and sugar in the sky. I imagine going fishing in clouds, and watching the sun hide behind lakes. I’m too busy dancing with my imagination to even tip toe with reality for a second. They say I’m going mad. They’re right.
author: D. Antoinette Foy

quote: The human heart beats approximately 4,000 times per hour and each pulse, each throb, each palpitation is a trophy engraved with the words ‘you are still alive.’ You are still alive. Act like it.
author: Rudy Francisco

quote:
When you choose to be a poet,
when you choose to spill like this,
bleed like this, cry like this,
your pain becomes an exhibit.
A place for people to walk through
and then leave when they are ready.
No one ever asks a museum if it’s okay.
author: Rudy Francisco

quote: Dead people receive more flowers than the living ones because the regret is stronger than gratitude.
author: Anne Frank

quote: What is done cannot be undone, but one can prevent it happening again.
author: Anne Frank

quote: Go outside, to the country, enjoy the sun and all nature has to offer. Go outside and try to recapture the happiness within yourself; think of all the beauty in yourself and in everything around you and be happy.
author: Anne Frank

quote: I love you. I worry about you. I wonder whether I tell you enough how I love you and want you and need you and how I am diminished when you are not with me and how I am multiplied when you are here.
author: Pat Frank

quote: What is to give light must endure burning.
author: Viktor Frankl

quote: Nice people don’t necessarily fall in love with nice people.
author: Jonathan Franzen

quote: I had learned early to assume something dark and lethal hidden at the heart of anything I loved. When I couldn't find it, I responded, bewildered and wary, in the only way I knew how: by planting it there myself.
author: Tana French

quote: I am not good at noticing when I’m happy, except in retrospect.
author: Tana French

quote: I used to think I was tough, but I've realized I wasn’t. I was fragile, and I wore thick fucking armor, and I hurt people so they couldn’t hurt me, and I thought that was what being tough was, but it isn’t.
author: James Frey

quote: Time does not change us. It just unfolds us.
author: Max Frisch

quote: In three words I can sum up everything I’ve learned about life: it goes on.
author: Robert Frost
source: as cited by Ray Josephs in The Cincinnati Enquirer, 1954 September 5 (x)

quote: Freedom lies in being bold.
author: Robert Frost
source: as cited by James Nelson in Wisdom: Conversations with the Elder Wise Men of Our Day

quote: O hushed October morning mild, begin the hours of this day slow. Make the day seem to us less brief.
author: Robert Frost

quote: The best way out is always through.
author: Robert Frost

quote:
Do not stand at my grave and weep
I am not there. I do not sleep.
I am a thousand winds that blow.
I am the diamond glints on snow.
I am the sunlight on ripened grain.
I am the gentle autumn rain.
When you awaken in the morning’s hush
I am the swift uplifting rush
Of quiet birds in circled flight.
I am the soft stars that shine at night.
Do not stand at my grave and cry;
I am not there. I did not die.
author: Mary Elizabeth Frye
source: Do Not Stand At My Grave And Weep

quote: We’re all a little weird. And life is a little weird. And when we find someone whose weirdness is compatible with ours, we join up with them and fall into mutually satisfying weirdness — and call it love.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: Books have to be heavy because the whole world’s inside them.
author: Cornelia Funke

quote: I really don’t know what ‘I love you’ means. I think it means ‘Don’t leave me here alone.’
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: It is astonishing just how much of what we are can be tied to the beds we wake up in in the morning, and it is astonishing how fragile that can be.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: Now you people have names. That’s because you don’t know who you are. We know who we are, so we don’t need names.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: I want to see life. I want to hold it in my hands.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: There was only a poem, which took flesh and walked and spread itself across the vastness of the known.
author: Neil Gaiman
source: How to Talk to Girls at Parties

quote: Have you ever been in love? Horrible, isn’t it? It makes you so vulnerable. It opens your chest and it opens your heart and it means that someone can get inside you and mess you up.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: I’ve been making a list of the things they don’t teach you at school. They don’t teach you how to love somebody. They don’t teach you how to be famous. They don’t teach you how to be rich or how to be poor. They don’t teach you how to walk away from someone you don’t love any longer. They don’t teach you how to know what’s going on in someone else’s mind. They don’t teach you what to say to someone who’s dying. They don’t teach you anything worth knowing.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: I think hell is something you carry around with you. Not somewhere you go.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: She says nothing at all, but simply stares upward into the dark sky and watches, with sad eyes, the slow dance of the infinite stars.
author: Neil Gaiman

quote: Not every girl survives the forest. Sometimes she becomes it.
author: Catherine Garbinsky

quote: In the story, you fall in love with a girl on another planet. She’s been dead for years, but through your telescope you watch her laugh, laughing too. You wave when she, remembering her smallness, remembers the stars.
author: Annelyse Gelman
source: Everyone I Love Is a Stranger to Someone, 2014: ‘Love Poem’

quote: I burned so long and so quiet, you must have wondered if I loved you back. I did, I did, I do.
author: Annelyse Gelman
source: Everyone I Love Is a Stranger to Someone, 2014: ‘The Pillowcase’

quote: If you ever ask me how many times you’ve crossed my mind, I would say once. Because you came, and never left.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: The best portion of your life will be the small, nameless moments you spend smiling with someone who matters to you.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: Thanks to those who hated me, you made me a stronger person. Thanks to those who loved me, you made my heart grow fonder. Thanks to those who envied me, you made my self-esteem increase. Thanks to those who cared, you made me feel important. Thanks to those who entered my life, you made me who I am today. Thanks to those who left, you showed me that nothing lasts forever. Thanks to those who stayed, you showed me the true meaning of friendship.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: Every child is born a naturalist. His eyes are, by nature, open to the glories of the stars, the beauty of the flowers, and the mystery of life.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: Positivity is not just expecting the best to happen, but also accepting that whatever happens is for the best.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: The human brain is amazing. It functions 24 hours a day from the time we were born, and only stops when we take an exam or when we are in love.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: It is during the worst times of your life that you will get to see the true colors of the people who say they care for you.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: I hope you never forget that there is someone who’s always by your side and he’ll always love you, always wants you, and always cares about you no matter what.
author: Ritu Ghatourey

quote: Improbable is not the opposite of probable, but rather an inflexion of it, a gradient in a continuum of probability. But what does probability — a mathematical idea — have to do with fiction? The answer is: everything. For, as Ian Hacking, a prominent historian of the concept, puts it, probability is a ‘manner of conceiving the world constituted without our being aware of it.’
author: Amitav Ghosh

quote: God said ‘love your enemy’ and I obeyed Him and loved myself.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Travel and tell no one, live a true love story and tell no one, live happily and tell no one, people ruin beautiful things.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote:
Just to be clear,
I don’t want to get out,
without a broken heart.
I intend to leave this life,
so shattered,
there’s gonna have to be,
a thousand separate heavens,
for all of my separate parts.
author: Andrea Gibson

quote: I said to the sun, ‘Tell me about the big bang.’ The sun said, ‘it hurts to become.’
author: Andrea Gibson
source: ‘I Sing the Body Electric, Especially When My Power's Out’

quote: It is better to be hated for what you are than to be loved for what you are not.
author: Andre Gide

quote: Some people are born with tornadoes in their lives, but constellations in their eyes. Other people are born with stars at their feet, but their souls are lost at sea.
author: Nikita Gill

quote: If you have been brutally broken, but still have the courage to be gentle to others, then you deserve a love deeper than the ocean itself.
author: Nikita Gill

quote: The night isn’t dark; the world is dark. Stay with me a little longer.
author: Louise Glück

quote:
There is no other immortality:
in the cold spring, the purple violets open.
author: Louise Glück

quote: Like the poets, are you stimulated by despair? Does grief move you to reveal your nature?
author: Louise Glück

quote: Anxiety is nothing but repeatedly re-experiencing failure in advance. What a waste.
author: Seth Godin

quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
author: Vincent van Gogh
source: in a letter to Theo van Gogh

quote: When I have a terrible need of ― shall I say the word ― religion, then I go out and paint the stars.
author: Vincent van Gogh
source: in a letter to Theo van Gogh

quote: But you must love with a high, serious intimate sympathy, with a will, with intelligence, and you must always seek to know more thoroughly, better, and more.
author: Vincent van Gogh
source: in a letter to Theo van Gogh

quote: I often think that the night is more alive and more richly colored than the day.
author: Vincent van Gogh
source: in a letter to Theo van Gogh

quote: I put my heart and my soul into my work and have lost my mind in the process.
author: Vincent van Gogh
source: in a letter to Theo van Gogh

quote: I don’t know when we’ll see each other again or what the world will be like when we do. We may both have seen many horrible things. But I will think of you every time I need to be reminded that there is beauty and goodness in the world.
author: Arthur Golden

quote: We all have hidden secrets, some funny, sweet, kind or even dirty. Mine though, is obvious. It’s there, it always has been. You just haven’t noticed. It’s you.
author: Isabelle Gough

quote: The moment comes when a character does or says something you hadn’t thought about. At that moment he’s alive and you leave it to him.
author: Graham Greene

quote: Hate was just a failure of the imagination.
author: Graham Greene

quote: Time can be slowed if you live deliberately. If you stop and watch sunsets. If you spend time sitting on porches listening to the woods. If you give in to the reality of the seasons.
author: Thomas Christopher Greene

quote: No one will understand you. It is not, ultimately, that important. What is important is that you understand you.
author: Matt Haig

quote: I’m having an argument with myself. And I’m losing.
author: Cynthia Hand

quote: The mind can go in a thousand directions, but on this beautiful path, I walk in peace. With each step, the wind blows. With each step, a flower blooms.
author: Thich Nhat Hanh

quote: The opposite of addiction isn’t sobriety. It’s connection. It’s all I can offer. It’s all that will help him in the end. If you are alone, you cannot escape addiction. If you are loved, you have a chance. For a hundred years we have been singing war songs about addicts. All along, we should have been singing love songs to them.
author: Johann Hari
source: Chasing the Scream: The First and Last Days of the War on Drugs, 2007

quote: I don’t want to be pitied and I don’t know how to be loved. I only know how to love. All I can do is hope I’m doing the right thing.
author: Keith Haring

quote: I’ve never been good at emotional stuff. Except anger. Anger, I’m good at.
author: Hannah Harrington

quote: Playing house can reconstruct the world.
author: Nanae Haruno

quote: If you’re really listening, if you’re awake to the poignant beauty of the world, your heart breaks regularly. In fact, your heart is made to break; its purpose is to burst open again and again so that it can hold evermore wonders.
author: Andrew Harvey

quote: Remember to look up at the stars and not down at your feet.
author: Stephen Hawking
source: ‘A Brief History of Mine’ (70th birthday lecture) January 8, 2012

quote: Quantum theory provides us with a striking illustration of the fact that we can fully understand a connection though we can only speak of it in images and parables.
author: Werner Heisenberg

quote: There is nothing to writing. All you do is sit down at a typewriter and bleed.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: The first and final thing you have to do in this world is last in it and not be smashed by it.
author: Ernest Hemingway
source: in a letter to Maxwell Perkins, c. April 1932

quote: The way to learn whether a person is trustworthy is to trust them.
author: Ernest Hemingway
source: as cited by A. E. Hotchner in Papa Hemingway, 1966

quote: If people bring so much courage to this world the world has to kill them to break them, so of course it kills them. The world breaks every one and afterward many are strong at the broken places. But those that will not break it kills. It kills the very good and the very gentle and the very brave impartially. If you are none of these you can be sure it will kill you too but there will be no special hurry.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: We would be together and have our books and at night be warm in bed together with the windows open and the stars bright.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: Man is not made for defeat.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: The true adventurer goes forth aimless and uncalculating to meet and greet unknown fate.
author: O. Henry

quote: He is sad. He sleeps for days on end. Neither good nor evil attract him. When he walks down the street, you see distinctly the motion of his rosy wings of lungs.
author: Zbigniew Herbert
source: ‘Anything Rather Than an Angel,’ translated by Czeslaw Milosz

quote:
You were holding whole kingdoms
but your palms were made of sand.
author: Elizabeth Hewer
source: Obituary for the Princess Who Forgot to Be Fairytale

quote: How fragile we are, between the few good moments.
author: Jane Hirshfield

quote: Desire, to know why, and how, CURIOSITY; such as is in no living creature but Man; so that Man is distinguished, not only by his Reason; but also by this singular Passion from other Animals; in whom the appetite of food, and other pleasures of Sense, by predominance, take away the care of knowing causes; which is a Lust of the mind, that by a perseverance of delight in the continual and indefatigable generation of Knowledge, exceedeth the short vehemence of any carnal Pleasure.
author: Thomas Hobbes

quote: It's no fun watching people wound themselves so that they can hole up, nurse themselves back to health and then repeat the cycle. They don't know what else to do”.
author: Jenny Holzer

quote: I did not like to be touched, but it was a strange dislike. I did not like to be touched because I craved it too much. I wanted to be held very tight so I would not break.
author: Marya Hornbacher
source: Wasted: A Memoir of Anorexia and Bulimia

quote: The fear is not of fat. The fear is of need, of hunger, of any desire, of life itself. The fear is of being human, and as such, imperfect, and as such, just mortal. Just a body, like everyone else.
author: Marya Hornbacher
source: Wasted: A Memoir of Anorexia and Bulimia

quote: Identity is a series of ads for a product that doesn’t exist… To put that tritely: The best way to be yourself is to not be anybody in particular but to just be.
author: Rob Horning

quote: I know you can and will destroy me, yet I don’t care… That’s the true beauty of our love.
author: Ryan P. Hughes

quote: You have enemies? Why, it is the story of every man who has done a great deed or created a new idea. It is the cloud which thunders around everything that shines. Fame must have enemies, as light must have gnats. Do not bother yourself about it; disdain. Keep your mind serene as you keep your life clear.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Half gods are worshiped in wine and flowers. Real gods require blood.
author: Zora Neale Hurston

quote: I don’t want comfort. I want God, I want poetry, I want real danger, I want freedom, I want goodness. I want sin.
author: Aldous Huxley

quote: That men do not learn very much from the lessons of history is the most important of all the lessons that history has to teach.
author: Aldous Huxley

quote: I continuously brooded on the problems of existence — free-will and determinism, the whence and why and whither of man, the origin of evil, the immortality of the soul, the futility of life, etc., and made myself very miserable over such questions.
author: George Du Maurier

quote: You wish to reform the world? Reform yourself, otherwise your efforts will be in vain.
author: St. Ignatius of Loyola
source: as cited by Daniello Bartoli in History of the Life and Institute of St. Ignatius De Loyola, Vol. 4

quote: Time is heavy. The world dense. The years brief. The seconds slow.
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: Amédée, or How to Get Rid of It, translated by Donald Watson

quote: It’s reality that makes us beautiful.
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: Amédée, or How to Get Rid of It, translated by Donald Watson

quote: Every voice echoes ours. Everything corresponds. We take each other by the hand. There is space, but no distance.
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: Amédée, or How to Get Rid of It, translated by Donald Watson

quote: The sparrows grew strong again in our hands, the flowers never faded.
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: Amédée, or How to Get Rid of It, translated by Donald Watson

quote: All the acacia trees are aglow. Their blossoms are bursting open and shooting up to the sky. The full-blown moon is flooding the Heavens with light, a living planet. The Milky Way is like creamy fire. Honeycombs, countless galaxies, comets’ tails, celestial ribbons, rivers of molten silver, and brooks, lakes and oceans of palpable light… Sheaves of blossoming snow, trees in the sky, gardens and meadows… domes and cupolas… columns and temples… And space, space, infinite space!
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: Amédée, or How to Get Rid of It, translated by Donald Watson

quote: The tragic character does not change, he is crushed; he is himself, he is real. Comic characers, fools, are people who do not exist.
author: Eugène Ionesco
source: ‘The Tragedy of Language: How an English Primer Became My First Play,’ translated by Jack Undank

quote: Someone who can’t sacrifice anything can never change anything. In order to overcome a monster, you must be willing to throw aside your humanity.
author: Hajime Isayama

quote: I just want the weak who do get swept along with the flow to be considered human too.
author: Hajime Isayama

quote: There was another life that I might have had, but I am having this one.
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
source: as cited in Conversations with Kazuo Ishiguro, 2008

quote: May those who accept their fate be granted happiness. May those who defy their fate be granted glory.
author: Ikuko Itoh

quote: All of my feelings belong to me. All feelings are precious to whom they belong. And I am nobody’s marionette.
author: Ikuko Itoh

quote: What I want is the soul of something buried deep inside me before it became these words.
author: Richard Jackson

quote: And remember this, that if you’ve been hated, you’ve also been loved.
author: Henry James

quote: You cannot shame a woman who owns everything about herself. You cannot weaponize the truth against her.
author: T. James

quote: The universe has no center. No center, no limits. We live in the midst of infinity.
author: Kristopher Jansma

quote: God is not death, God is what survives.
author: Mark Jarman

quote: We can never be gods, after all; but we can become something less than human with frightening ease.
author: N.K. Jemisin

quote: The first and foremost instinct of humans is neither sex nor aggression. It is to seek contact and comforting connection.
author: Sue Johnson
source: Love Sense: The Revolutionary New Science of Romantic Relationships

quote: Finally, in a low whisper, he said, ‘I think I might be a terrible person.’ For a split second I believed him — I thought he was about to confess a crime, maybe a murder. Then I realized that we all think we might be terrible people. But we only reveal this before asking someone to love us. It is a kind of undressing.
author: Miranda July

quote: What a terrible mistake to let go of something wonderful for something real.
author: Miranda July
source: No One Belongs Here More Than You

quote: No tree, it is said, can grow to heaven unless its roots reach down to hell.
author: C.G. Jung

quote: I hate the fact that I don’t hate you, not even a little.
author: Gil Junger

quote:
I aim to be
lionhearted,
but my
hands still
shake
and my voice
isn’t quite
loud
enough.
author: Michelle K.

quote:
My poor mother
begged for a sheep
but raised a wolf.
author: Michelle K.

quote: The little things? The little moments? — They aren’t little.
author: Jon Kabat-Zinn

quote: What do you say when you’re not enough to make someone stay?
author: Katie Kacvinsky

quote: I cannot force my way into the world, but lie quietly, receive, spread out within me what I have received, and then step calmly forth.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: Why couldn’t one set oneself afire and be destroyed in the flames? Or obey, even if one hears no command? Or sit on a chair in the middle of one’s empty room and look at the floor?
author: Franz Kafka

quote: I never wish to be easily defined. I’d rather float over other people’s minds as something strictly fluid and non-perceivable; more like a transparent, paradoxically iridescent creature rather than an actual person.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: When dealing with myself I am powerless.
author: Franz Kafka
source: in a letter to Felice Bauer

quote: You are free and that is why you are lost.
author: Franz Kafka
source: in a letter to Felice Bauer

quote: I usually solve problems by letting them devour me.
author: Franz Kafka
source: in a letter to Max Brod

quote: You are the knife I turn inside myself; that is love. That, my dear, is love.
author: Franz Kafka
source: in a letter to Milena Jesenská

quote: You misinterpret everything, even the silence.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: I cannot rid myself of the feeling that I’m not in the right place.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: None sing as purely as those in deepest Hell; it is their singing that we take for the singing of angels.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: Blue is the typical heavenly colour. The ultimate feeling it creates is one of rest. When it sinks to almost black, it echoes grief that is hardly human.
author: Wassily Kandinsky

quote: What I sometimes mistake for ecstasy is simply the absence of grief.
author: Sarah Kane

quote: I am trying to write a poem in which I am neither a monster nor a martyr.
author: Kevin Kantor

quote: People who didn’t live pre-Internet can’t grasp how devoid of ideas life in my hometown was. The only bookstores sold Bibles the size of coffee tables and dashboard Virgin Marys that glowed in the dark. I stopped in the middle of the SAT to memorize a poem, because I thought, This is a great work of art and I’ll never see it again.
author: Mary Karr

quote: Character, like a photograph, develops in darkness.
author: Yousuf Karsh

quote: I didn’t leave because I stopped loving you. I left because the longer I stayed the less I loved myself.
author: Rupi Kaur

quote: I’ve never seen grief like it. Grief like that, it’s like an animal. She’s not eating. She’s not sleeping. She’s whimpering. She’s sluggish. She’s not herself.
author: Jackie Kay

quote:
Straight off and away into the dreamy dark.
I’ve never had so much peace in my life.
And silence. Silence and more silence. Thick like snow.
author: Jackie Kay

quote: I think many people kill themselves simply to stop the debate about whether they will or they won’t.
author: Susanna Kaysen

quote: I’m a wretch. But I love, love.
author: Jack Kerouac

quote: People often ask me questions that I cannot very well answer in words, and it makes me sad to think they are unable to hear the voice of my silence.
author: Hazrat Inayat Khan
source: The Complete Sayings of Hazrat Inayat Khan, 1978

quote:
Are you accidental—Temporary?
Does the moon sink
in your skin; are the daffodils
talking again?
author: S.A. Khanum

quote: We need falsifications to make the past inhabitable.
author: Frans Kellendonk

quote: A candle loses nothing by lighting another.
author: James Keller

quote: Do it or don’t do it — you will regret both.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

quote: I have only one confidant, and that is the silence of night.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

quote: The most common form of despair is not being who you are.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

quote: It’s all about falling in love with yourself and sharing that love with someone who appreciates you, rather than looking for love to compensate for a self love deficit.
author: Eartha Kitt
source: as cited in All by Myself: The Eartha Kitt Story, 1982

quote: Love isn’t soft, like those poets say. Love has teeth which bite and the wounds never close.
author: Stephen King

quote: When it came to the dark fuckery of the human heart, there seemed to be no limit.
author: Stephen King

quote: You think ‘Okay, I get it, I’m prepared for the worst’, but you hold out that small hope, see, and that’s what fucks you up. That’s what kills you.
author: Stephen King

quote: It’s hard to let go. Even when what you’re holding onto is full of thorns, it’s hard to let go. Maybe especially then.
author: Stephen King

quote: Sometimes real love is silent as well as blind.
author: Stephen King

quote: Art and love are the same thing: It’s the process of seeing yourself in things that are not you.
author: Chuck Klosterman
source: Killing Yourself to Live: 85% of a True Story

quote: Destruction can be beautiful to some people. Don’t ask me why. It just is. And if they can’t find anything to destroy, they destroy themselves.
author: John Knowles

quote: I need to be alone for certain periods of time or I violate my own rhythm.
author: Lee Krasner
source: as cited by Cindy Nemser in Art Talk: Conversations With 15 Women Artists

quote: She believed a great happiness awaited her somewhere, and for this reason she remained calm as the days flew by.
author: Gyula Krúdy

quote: Repeating the same action but expecting new results is a sign of madness. It's also a sign that you are human.
author: Kumobius

quote: I think I am a better ghost than I am a human being.
author: Mikko Kuorinki

quote: Either you don’t communicate enough and remain concealed from other people, or you risk rejection by exposing too much altogether: the minor and major hurts, the tedious obsessions, the abscesses and cataracts of need and shame and longing.
author: Olivia Laing

quote: We have a far greater connection to the fictional characters we know and love than the random people we pass on the street.
author: Sam Lake

quote: You own everything that happened to you. Tell your stories. If people wanted you to write warmly about them, they should’ve behaved better.
author: Anne Lamott
source: Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

quote: Can you remember who you were, before the world told you who you should be?
author: Danielle LaPorte

quote:
They fuck you up, your mum and dad. 
They may not mean to, but they do.
They fill you with the faults they had
And add some extra, just for you.
author: Philip Larkin

quote:
But they were fucked up in their turn
By fools in old-style hats and coats,
Who half the time were soppy-stern
And half at one another’s throats.
author: Philip Larkin

quote:
Man hands on misery to man.
It deepens like a coastal shelf.
Get out as early as you can,
And don’t have any kids yourself.
author: Philip Larkin

quote: Which do you want: the pain of staying where you are, or the pain of growth?
author: Judith Hanson Lasater
source: A Year of Living Your Yoga: Daily Practices to Shape Your Life

quote: Memories are dangerous things. You turn them over and over, until you know every touch and corner, but still you’ll find an edge to cut you.
author: Mark Lawrence

quote: Always loving, always judging, always destroying.
author: Violette Leduc

quote: Let desert sand harden your feet. Let the arch of your feet be the mountains. Let the paths of your fingertips be your maps and the ways you go be the lines of your palms. May your mouth contain the shapes of strange words. May you smell food cooking you have not eaten. May the spring of a foreign river be your navel. May your soul be at home where there are no houses.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: If a soldier is imprisoned by the enemy, don’t we consider it his duty to escape? The moneylenders, the knownothings, the authoritarians have us all in prison; if we value the freedom of the mind and soul, if we’re partisans of liberty, then it’s our plain duty to escape, and to take as many people with us as we can.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
source: The Language of the Night: Essays on Fantasy and Science Fiction, ‘Escape Routes,’ 1974

quote: Love doesn’t just sit there, like a stone, it has to be made, like bread; remade all the time, made new.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: The trouble is that we have a bad habit, encouraged by pedants and sophisticates, of considering happiness as something rather stupid. Only pain is intellectual, only evil interesting. This is the treason of the artist; a refusal to admit the banality of evil and the terrible boredom of pain.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
source: The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas, 1973

quote: Happiness is based on a just discrimination of what is necessary, what is neither necessary nor destructive, and what is destructive.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
source: The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas, 1973

quote: The joy built upon successful slaughter is not the right kind of joy; it will not do; it is fearful and it is trivial.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
source: The Ones Who Walk Away from Omelas, 1973

quote: We all have forests on our minds. Forests unexplored, unending. Each one of us gets lost in the forest, every night, alone.
author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quote: Sympathy’s easy. You have sympathy for starving children swatting at flies on the late-night commercials. Sympathy is easy because it comes from a position of power. Empathy is getting down on your knees and looking someone else in the eye and realizing you could be them, and that all that separates you is luck.
author: Dennis Lehane

quote: Answerless questions can destroy you. Move on.
author: David Levithan

quote: This is what love does: it makes you want to rewrite the world. It makes you want to choose the characters, build the scenery, guide the plot. The person you love sits across from you, and you want to do everything in your power to make it possible, endlessly possible. And when it’s just the two of you, alone in a room, you can pretend that this is how it is, this is how it will be.
author: David Levithan

quote: Ultimately, the universe doesn’t care about us. Time doesn’t care about us. That’s why we have to care about each other.
author: David Levithan

quote: Let’s always love each other, and never be in love with each other.
author: David Levithan

quote: I am not ready to see what happens next. Because it’s possible that nothing will happen, and that might break me.
author: David Levithan

quote: There has to be a moment at the beginning when you wonder whether you’re in love with the person or in love with the feeling of love itself.
author: David Levithan

quote: Even when I detach, I care. You can be separate from a thing and still care about it.
author: David Levithan

quote: Our Father refreshes us on the journey with some pleasant inns, but will not encourage us to mistake them for home.
author: C.S. Lewis

quote: To be eaten and to be married to the god might not be so different.
author: C.S. Lewis
source: Till We Have Faces: A Myth Retold

quote: Holy places are dark places. It is life and strength, not knowledge and words, that we get in them. Holy wisdom is not clear and thin like water, but thick and dark like blood.
author: C.S. Lewis
source: Till We Have Faces: A Myth Retold

quote:
I feel like a time traveler:
June, July, August.
Summer dissolves in my mouth
and I can’t remember what it tasted like.
author: Zoë Lianne

quote: When I was about 20 years old, I met an old pastor’s wife who told me that when she was young and had her first child, she didn’t believe in striking children, although spanking kids with a switch pulled from a tree was standard punishment at the time. But one day, when her son was four or five, he did something that she felt warranted a spanking – the first in his life. She told him that he would have to go outside himself and find a switch for her to hit him with.
author: Astrid Lindgren

quote: The boy was gone a long time. And when he came back in, he was crying. He said to her, ‘Mama, I couldn’t find a switch, but here’s a rock that you can throw at me.’
author: Astrid Lindgren

quote: All of a sudden the mother understood how the situation felt from the child’s point of view: that if my mother wants to hurt me, then it makes no difference what she does it with; she might as well do it with a stone.
author: Astrid Lindgren

quote: And the mother took the boy into her lap and they both cried. Then she laid the rock on a shelf in the kitchen to remind herself forever: never violence. And that is something I think everyone should keep in mind. Because if violence begins in the nursery one can raise children into violence.
author: Astrid Lindgren

quote: Isn’t everything we do in life a way to be loved a little more?
author: Richard Linklater

quote: And so she had lain on the earth, resting her entire body until she was absorbed by God.
author: Clarice Lispector
source: An Apprenticeship, or, The Book of Delights, 1973

quote: It’s uncomfortable being two: me for me and me for others.
author: Clarice Lispector

quote: I think we have to do forbidden things — otherwise we suffocate.
author: Clarice Lispector

quote: I am troubled and harsh and hopeless. Though I have love inside me. But I don’t know how to use love. Sometimes it scratches like barbs.
author: Clarice Lispector

quote: She knows what she wants: she wants to remain standing still in the sea. And so she remains. The woman neither receives nor transmits. She does not need to communicate. She knows that she is gleaming from the water, the salt and the sun. In some obscure way her dripping hair is like that of a shipwrecked person.
author: Clarice Lispector

quote: I am always remote from myself, I am unreachable to myself just as a star is unreachable for me. I contort myself to be able to touch the present time that surrounds me, but I remain remote in relation to this very instant itself. The future, God help me, is closer to me than the present instant.
author: Clarice Lispector

quote: Because she couldn’t tell an iamb apart from the Lamb; because she smelled of soap and sunlight; because when she told him she would go look at stars with him she really meant it; because when he made fun of people who said ‘irregardless,’ she made him look it up in a dictionary so that he learned that it really was a word; because he knew that he could always tell when she would laugh a fraction of a second before she did.
author: Ken Liu

quote: I had another feeling, that the earth is like a vibrant living thing. The vessels we’ve clearly seen on it looked like the blood and veins of human beings. I said to myself: this is the place we live, it’s really magical.
author: Yang Liu
source: as cited by David B. Yaden in The Overview Effect: Awe and Self-Transcendent Experience in Space Flight

quote: Give what you have. To someone, it may be better than you dare to think.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: A thousand butterfly skeletons sleep within my walls.
author: Federico García Lorca

quote: All in this world has broken. All that’s left is silence. (Leave me in this field weeping.)
author: Federico García Lorca

quote: The jasmine is a water without blood, and the girl a nocturnal branch across the pavement, infinitely dark.
author: Federico García Lorca
source: ‘Qasida of the Dream of Open Air’

quote: I used to think rewatching and rereading were embarrassingly boring pastimes. But there is something to be said for how comforting it is to already know what happens. There is no such luxury in real life.
author: Emery Lord

quote: You cannot use someone else’s fire; you can only use your own. And in order to do that, you must first be willing to believe you have it.
author: Audre Lorde

quote: What are the words you do not yet have? What do you need to say? What are the tyrannies you swallow day by day and attempt to make your own, until you will sicken and die of them, still in silence?
author: Audre Lorde
source: I Am Your Sister: Collected and Unpublished Writings of Audre Lorde, ‘The Transformation of Silence into Language and Action’

quote: I am deliberate and afraid of nothing.
author: Audre Lorde

quote: As soon as a challenge was overcome, it ceased to be a challenge, becoming the expected and ordinary rather than something I had achieved with difficulty, and could, therefore, be justly proud of. I could not own my own triumphs, nor give myself credit for them.
author: Audre Lorde
source: Zami: A New Spelling of My Name

quote: Jessica has a forehead scar from the deep end of a pool. I ask Jessica what drowning feels like and she says not everything feels like something else.
author: Angie Sijun Lou

quote: Sadly, it’s much easier to create a desert than a forest.
author: James Lovelock

quote: You are valuable because you exist. Not because of what you do or what you have done but simply because you are.
author: Max Lucado
source: You'll Get Through This: Hope and Help for Your Turbulent Times

quote: What I also mean to say is that I recognize the focus. The impulse to know someone else before you reveal yourself. The impulse to know someone else because you have never been asked to reveal yourself. The impulse to know someone else because otherwise, you do not know yourself. The impulse to know someone else because you are self-conscious of your whole self, the one that fills up too many rooms, so much space. The impulse to hide how much space you need. The impulse to hide what you need.
author: Yanyi Luo

quote: You could rattle the stars. You could do anything, if only you dared. And deep down, you know it too. That’s what scares you the most.
author: Sarah J. Maas

quote: It is a common delusion that you make things better by talking about them.
author: Rose Macaulay

quote: To be trusted is a greater compliment than to be loved.
author: George Macdonald

quote: Yes, for myself alone I bloom, in isolation!
author: Stéphane Mallarmé
source: Collected Poems and Other Verse, ‘The Nurse and Herodias’

quote: There is not enough of me left for myself.
author: Osip Mandelstam

quote: Oh, I could weep like a child because there are so many flowers and my lap is so small and all must be carried home…
author: Katherine Mansfield
source: in a letter to John Middleton Murry

quote: A lie is more comfortable than doubt, more useful than love, more lasting than truth.
author: Gabriel García Márquez

quote: There is no shame in fear… what matters is how we face it.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: When you tear out a man's tongue, you are not proving him a liar, you're only telling the world that you fear what he might say.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Sorcery is the sauce fools spoon over failure to hide the flavor of their own incompetence.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: A good act does not wash out the bad, nor a bad act the good. Each should have its own reward.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: The brightest flame casts the darkest shadows.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Love is poison. A sweet poison, yes, but it will kill you all the same.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: People often claim to hunger for truth, but seldom like the taste when it's served up.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: So many vows… they make you swear and swear. Defend the king. Obey the king. Keep his secrets. Do his bidding. Your life for his. But obey your father. Love your sister. Protect the innocent. Defend the weak. Respect the gods. Obey the laws. It's too much. No matter what you do, you're forsaking one vow or the other.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Tears… The woman's weapon, my lady mother used to call them. The man's weapon is a sword. And that tells us all you need to know, doesn't it?
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: ‘Can a man still be brave if he's afraid?’ ‘That is the only time a man can be brave.’
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: If you would take a man’s life, you owe it to him to look into his eyes and hear his final words. And if you cannot bear to do that, then perhaps the man does not deserve to die.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: A ruler who hides behind paid executioners soon forgets what death is.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Never forget what you are, for surely the world will not. Make it your strength. Then it can never be your weakness. Armor yourself in it, and it will never be used to hurt you.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: Death is so terribly final, while life is full of possibilities.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: A mind needs books as a sword needs a whetstone, if it is to keep its edge.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: We all need to be mocked from time to time, lest we start to take ourselves too seriously.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: There are no heroes… In life, the monsters win.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: All men are fools, if truth be told, but the ones in motley are more amusing than ones with crowns.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: One voice may speak you false, but in many there is always truth to be found.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: In the world as I have seen it, no man grows rich by kindness.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: It seems to me that a queen who trusts no one is as foolish as a queen who trusts everyone.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: When the sun has set, no candle can replace it.
author: George R.R. Martin

quote: When I look back upon my path, I realize my one consistent motif in my work was my obsession for small things. I feel joy when I discover seemingly insignificant things that may be easily overlooked.
author: Yamamoto Masao

quote: You will either step forward into growth, or you will step backward into safety.
author: Abraham Maslow
Trista Mateer

quote:
and I wanted to ask her if that meant I would fall for a fighter
and a hard fist and a fast car,
boys on motorcycles,
people who ran from their problems,
midnight phone calls from the beds of other women,
slippery mouths with tongues that twisted truth like cherry stems
author: Trista Mateer

quote: or if that meant I might just be comfortable with absence.
author: Trista Mateer

quote: A sick thought can devour the body’s flesh more than fever or consumption.
author: Guy de Maupassant

quote:
I still make the sign
of the cross when
I hear your name.
author: J. McCann

quote: There is an ugly name for those who do things the hard way.
author: American McGee

quote: When the storm rips you to pieces, you get to decide how to put yourself back together again.
author: Bryant McGill
source: Simple Reminders: Inspiration for Living Your Best Life

quote: Do not be too quick to condemn the man who no longer believes in God; for it is perhaps your own coldness and avarice and mediocrity and materialism and selfishness that have chilled his faith.
author: Thomas Merton

quote: If you want to identify me, ask me not where I live, or what I like to eat, or how I comb my hair, but ask me what I am living for, in detail, ask me what I think is keeping me from living fully for the thing I want to live for.
author: Thomas Merton

quote: All through the dark the wind looks for the grief it belongs to.
author: W.S. Merwin

quote: And later, when I began to write down the events of my childhood in a language foreign to their happening, it was a revelation. English could protect me; an alphabet without memory.
author: Anne Michaels

quote: A song from another time survived with me. It follows me wherever I go.
author: Dunta Mikhail

quote: We sit in each other’s souls.
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay
source: in a letter to Witter Bynner

quote: Nobody speaks to me. People fall in love with me, and annoy me and distress me and flatter me and excite me and all that sort of thing. But no one speaks to me. I sometimes think that no one can. Can you?
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay
source: as cited by Daniel Mark Epstein in What Lips My Lips Have Kissed: The Loves and Love Poems of Edna St. Vincent Millay

quote: I think we dream so we don’t have to be apart for so long. If we’re in each other’s dreams, we can be together all the time.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: I used to believe in forever, but forever’s too good to be true.
author: A.A. Milne
