quote: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: If ever there is tomorrow when we’re not together… there is something you must always remember. You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think. But the most important thing is, even if we’re apart… I’ll always be with you.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: Forever isn’t long at all, as long as I’m with you.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: How lucky I am to have something that makes saying goodbye so hard.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: Some people care too much. I think it’s called love.
author: A.A. Milne

quote: It’s not that anyone else has isolated me, but I have happily isolated myself. When I am alone, I feel natural, truthful, and at ease. Still, I feel I am not isolated enough, so I want to film more pure states of isolation. Perhaps true isolation is true freedom.
author: Tsai Ming-Liang

quote: They say you don’t get over someone until you find someone or something better. As humans, we don’t deal well with emptiness. Any empty space must be filled. Immediately. The pain of emptiness is too strong. It compels the victim to fill that place. A single moment with that empty spot causes excruciating pain. That’s why we run from distraction to distraction and from attachment to attachment.
author: Yasmin Mogahed
source: Fall in Love with the Real Thing

quote:
And I dream too much
and I don’t write enough
and I’m trying to find God everywhere.
author: Anis Mojgai
source: ‘For Those Who Can Still Ride in an Airplane For the First Time’

quote: ‘Dear old world’, she murmured, ‘you are very lovely, and I am glad to be alive in you.’
author: L.M. Montgomery

quote: You are beautiful because you let yourself feel, and that is a brave thing indeed.
author: Shinji Moon

quote: There is a face beneath this mask, but it isn’t me. I am no more that face than I am the muscles beneath it, or the bones beneath that.
author: Steve Moore

quote: Edit your life frequently and ruthlessly. It’s your masterpiece, after all.
author: Nathan W. Morris

quote: I touched her thigh and death smiled.
author: Jim Morrison

quote: It’s funny, in a human kind of way, how we can convince ourselves that we’re in control at the very moment we are beginning to lose it.
author: William C. Moyers
source: Broken: My Story of Addiction and Redemption, 2007

quote:
But this body
is home, my childhood
is buried here, my sleep
rises and sets inside,
desire
crested and wore itself thin
between these bones -
I live here.
author: Lisel Mueller

quote: From my rotting body, flowers shall grow and I am in them and that is eternity.
author: Edvard Munch
source: as cited by William Thompson and Kim Sorvig in Sustainable Landscape Construction: A Guide to Green Building Outdoors

quote: In a sense, I’m the one who ruined me. I did it myself.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: Violence does not always take visible form, and not all wounds gush blood.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: You can keep as quiet as you like, but one of these days somebody is going to find you.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: We cannot simply sit and stare at our wounds forever.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: I used to think the years would go by in order, that you get older one year at a time. But it’s not like that. It happens overnight.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: And you really will have to make it through that violent, metaphysical, symbolic storm. No matter how metaphysical or symbolic it might be, make no mistake about it: it will cut through flesh like a thousand razor blades. People will bleed there, and you will bleed too. Hot, red blood. You’ll catch that blood in your hands, your own blood and the blood of others.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: And once the storm is over you won’t remember how you made it through, how you managed to survive. You won’t even be sure, in fact, whether the storm is really over. But one thing is certain. When you come out of the storm you won’t be the same person who walked in. That’s what this storm’s all about.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: My point is: in this whole wide world the only person you can depend on is you.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: If you only read the books that everyone else is reading, you can only think what everyone else is thinking.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: I’m not totally mad at you. I’m just sad. You’re all locked up in that little world of yours, and when I try knocking on the door, you just sort of look up for a second and go right back inside.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: I have a million things to talk to you about. All I want in this world is you. I want to see you and talk. I want the two of us to begin everything from the beginning.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: We’re all kind of weird and twisted and drowning.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: I want you always to remember me. Will you remember that I existed, and that I stood next to you here like this?
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: Sometimes I feel like a caretaker of a museum — a huge, empty museum where no one ever comes, and I’m watching over it for no one but myself.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: What really hurts, though, is that I want to tell you everything — absolutely everything — but I just can’t do it. I can’t tell you exactly how I feel.
author: Haruki Murakami

quote: I do not care who I was before I came to be myself. I am no one but myself. That is the only truth.
author: Shūkō Murase

quote: I just can’t live an ordinary life, I can’t pass the time. I can’t organise myself, I don’t have ordinary motives anymore. I can’t even manage my body, when I go to bed I don’t know where to put my arms.
author: Iris Murdoch

quote: Think lightly of yourself and deeply of the world.
author: Miyamoto Musashi

quote: You can only fight the way you practice.
author: Miyamoto Musashi

quote: I dreamt of you last night — as if I was playing the piano and you were turning the pages for me.
author: Vladimir Nabokov
source: in a letter to Véra Nabokov, 12 January 1924

quote: In my dreams the world would come alive, becoming so captivatingly majestic, free and ethereal, that afterwards it would be oppressive to breathe the dust of this painted life.
author: Vladimir Nabokov

quote: She was all rose and honey.
author: Vladimir Nabokov

quote: Loneliness as a situation can be corrected, but as a state of mind it is an incurable illness.
author: Vladimir Nabokov

quote: The only way to truly escape the mundane is for you to constantly be evolving.
author: Ryōgo Narita

quote: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it’s all over.
author: Gloria Naylor

quote: Any fixed claim on realness, especially when it is tied to an identity, has a finger in psychosis.
author: Maggie Nelson

quote: But my words become stained with your love. You occupy everything, you occupy everything.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: The sea is working, working in my silence.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: You can cut all the flowers but you cannot keep spring from coming.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: Life is boring, except for flowers, sunshine, your perfect legs. A glass of cold water when you are really thirsty. The way bodies fit together. Fresh and young and sweet. Coffee in the morning. These are just moments. I struggle with the in-betweens. I just want to never stop loving like there is nothing else to do, because what else is there to do?
author: Pablo Neruda
source: Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair, 1924

quote: When they were together like that, they had been their own private universe, bounded just by themselves, a population of two. They were the world, and the world was them.
author: Patrick Ness

quote:
‘If I don’t want it – power – then
it won’t hurt when I can’t have it.’
But you can have it. Don’t you feel it?
Some repressed ambition stirring
nauseously inside you. The piece
of Eve’s apple that won’t digest.
The slow monstering of you
when you have to remind
yourself to smile and be nice.
The tiger hinging on its hind legs.
Don’t be grateful. Be ungrateful.
Be on your last nerve. Get ready.
author: Mindy Nettifee
source: For Young Women Who Don't Consider Themselves Feminists

quote: If I have seen further it is only by standing on the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton
source: in a letter to Robert Hooke

quote: ‘Just kidding’ was exactly what people wrote when they meant every word.
author: David Nicholls

quote:
God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change,
The courage to change the things I can,
And wisdom to know the difference.
author: Reinhold Niebuhr

quote: When we are tired, we are attacked by ideas we conquered long ago.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Our greatest experiences are our quiet moments.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: People like me love only ghosts. If I ever loved a human being — I would soon go to ruin.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
source: in a letter to Franz Overbeck

quote: A thought, even a possibility, can shatter and transform us.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: Look there: how she approaches impatiently over the sea. Do you not feel the thirst and the hot breath of her love? She would suck at the sea and drink its depth into her heights; and the sea’s desire rises toward her with a thousand breasts. It wants to be kissed and sucked by the thirst of the sun; it wants to become air and height and a footpath of light, and itself light.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: The lonely one offers his hand too quickly to whomever he encounters.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote:
I don’t know who I am anymore.
The previous sentence is a lie.
The previous sentence is a lie.
author: Jackson Nieuwland

quote: She answered, ‘I don’t want worship. I want understanding.’
author: Anaïs Nin

quote: You cannot save people, you can only love them.
author: Anaïs Nin

quote: I'm restless. Things are calling me away. My hair is being pulled by the stars again.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Fire: From A Journal of Love: the Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin (1934–1937)

quote: He cries, ‘Tell me, tell me what you feel.’ And I cannot. There is blood in my eyes, in my head. Words are drowned.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Henry and June: From A Journal of Love: the Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin (1931–1932)

quote: I am again devouring myself.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Henry and June: From A Journal of Love: the Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin (1931–1932)

quote: I have no longer the strength to act what I do not feel.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Mirages: The Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin, 1939-1947

quote: My whole being calls for an act of violence, but I still use velvet gloves.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Mirages: The Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin, 1939-1947

quote: My God, does love ever die? I ask, and will die asking.
author: Anaïs Nin
source: Nearer the Moon: From a Journal of Love: the Unexpurgated Diary of Anaïs Nin (1937–1939)

quote: Does the walker choose the path or the path the walker?
author: Garth Nix

quote: We all lie to ourselves to be happy.
author: Christopher Nolan

quote: Don’t assume your dreams are just fantasy. If you can imagine a world, believe in it… and dive in.
author: Tetsuya Nomura

quote: Dreams are illustrations from the book your soul is writing about you.
author: Marsha Norman

quote: You have to really be broken in order to be a poet. It’s a very bad thing to tell a young person, but it’s true. Poetry comes out of all the place where you break.
author: Alice Notley
source: in an interview conducted c. October 2015

quote:
I will search for you after your death, to confront you.
I will pose to you your timelessness and lack of fixity. I will say you have now never won.
I will search for you across heaven, for you marked me when I was indistinct, when I was loving, I say.
author: Alice Notley
source: In the Pines, ‘The Black Trailor (A Noir Fiction)’

quote: I don't have a plan. I have a voice.
author: Alice Notley
source: In the Pines, ‘The Black Trailor (A Noir Fiction)’

quote: Occasionally, however, a woman writer is told gravely, ‘You write like a man.’ Since this is the highest accolade, presented as a judgment from above and closed to any further discussion, it would be impolite to ask, ‘Which man? Any man? You?’
author: Joyce Carol Oates

quote: What sticks to memory, often, are those odd little fragments that have no beginning and no end…
author: Tim O'Brien The Things They Carried

quote: When it was dark, you always carried the sun in your hand for me.
author: Seán O’Casey

quote: When you bring a weapon into this world, you have to take responsibility. It doesn’t matter if you’re the one who pulls the trigger; they still have the power to hurt someone. And that someone could be a person you love.
author: Eiichiro Oda

quote: The Manicheans believed the world was filled with imprisoned light, fragments of a God who destroyed himself because he no longer wished to exist. This light could be found trapped inside man and animals and plants, and the Manichean mission was to try to release it.
author: Jenny Offill

quote: Yesterday seems years ago — even this morning seems years ago.
author: Georgia O’Keeffe
source: in a letter to Alfred Stieglitz

quote: I have done nothing all summer but wait for myself to be myself again.
author: Georgia O’Keeffe
source: in a letter to Russel Vernon Hunter

quote: Sometimes people stop loving you. And that’s the kind of darkness that never gets fixed, no matter how many moons rise again…
author: Lauren Oliver

quote: You do not have to be good. You do not have to walk on your knees for a hundred miles through the desert, repenting. You only have to let the soft animal of your body love what it loves. Tell me about despair, yours, and I will tell you mine. Meanwhile the world goes on.
author: Mary Oliver

quote:
And yet I swear
I love this earth
that scars and scalds,
that burns my feet.
author: Gregory Orr
source: The Caged Owl: New and Selected Poems, ‘Tin Cup’

quote: And even hell is holy.
author: Gregory Orr
source: The Caged Owl: New and Selected Poems, ‘Tin Cup’

quote: Perhaps one did not want to be loved so much as to be understood.
author: George Orwell

quote: Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.
author: George Orwell

quote: Perhaps a lunatic was simply a minority of one.
author: George Orwell

quote: Man is the only creature that consumes without producing. He does not give milk, he does not lay eggs, he is too weak to pull the plough, he cannot run fast enough to catch rabbits. Yet he is lord of all the animals.
author: George Orwell

quote: I’ve always thought of writing as the opposite of suicide; that writing was about immortality. Defeating death, or at least forestalling it.
author: Ruth Ozeki

quote: Never beg for anything. Earn it. Demand it. Seek it. Never beg for it.
author: Geraldine Page
source: as cited by James Grissom in Follies of God: Tennessee Williams and the Women of the Fog

quote: I have acid rain in my brain and it’s killing the flowers in my heart.
author: Marianna Paige

quote: We all die. The goal isn’t to live forever. The goal is to create something that will.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: Your handwriting. The way you walk. Which china pattern you choose. It's all giving you away. Everything you do shows your hand. Everything is a self-portrait. Everything is a diary.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: She’s confused and afraid to commit to the wrong thing, so she won’t commit to anything.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: This is your life and it’s ending one minute at a time.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: Never lose the childlike wonder. It’s just too important. It’s what drives us.
author: Randy Pausch

quote: We cannot change the cards we are dealt, just how we play the hand.
author: Randy Pausch

quote:
Somewhere in the middle:
a girl falls in love with an angel.
Wings tipped gold and prayers
in their blood-stained kisses.
Even God is laughing now.
author: M.J. Pearl

quote:
Tonight’s more apricots
and longing, a yellow so red
author: Emily Pérez
source: House of Sugar, House of Stone, 2016: ‘Raveling Round the Lake’

quote:
an orange inflamed
with warming, oh, to swallow
all that waning sun.
author: Emily Pérez
source: House of Sugar, House of Stone, 2016: ‘Raveling Round the Lake’

quote: I am hard on myself. But isn’t it better to be honest about these things before someone else can use them against you? Before someone else can break your heart? Isn’t it better to break it yourself?
author: Stephanie Perkins

quote: Let me tell you this: if you meet a loner, no matter what they tell you, it’s not because they enjoy solitude. It’s because they have tried to blend into the world before, and people continue to disappoint them.
author: Jodi Picoult

quote: You don’t need water to feel like you’re drowning, do you?
author: Jodi Picoult

quote: August rain: the best of the summer gone, and the new fall not yet born. The odd uneven time.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: I desire the things which will destroy me in the end.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: November night. Brief note to self: Time to take myself in hand. To build into myself, to give myself backbone, however much I fail.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: I need a father, I need a mother, I need some older, wiser being to cry to. I talk to God, but the sky is empty.
author: Sylvia Plath
source: in a letter to Richard Sassoon

quote: All the noise and music can not cover up the emptiness that lies beneath.
author: Sylvia Plath
source: in a letter to Hans-Joachim Neupert, c. January 1950

quote: I am glad the rain is coming down hard. It’s the way I feel inside.
author: Sylvia Plath
source: in a letter to Aurelia Plath, c. November 1950

quote: The silence depressed me. It wasn’t the silence of silence. It was my own silence.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: I am myself. That is not enough.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote:
Dying
Is an art, like everything else.
I do it exceptionally well.
I do it so it feels like hell.
I do it so it feels real.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: There is something about the achingly bright expanse of blue that makes me feel infinitely placid, infinitely calm, infinitely spacious. Something there is about the ceaseless, unperturbed ebb and flow, about the vast masses of green-blue water, that heals all my uneasy questionings and self-searchings.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: The sea… it keeps washing you up like an old bone. And I, on the sky-mirroring, bland sands, find you over and over, lipped like a skate and smiling, with the sound of the sea in your mouth. Angel of coldness, surely it is not I you want so badly.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: It is the exception that interests the devil.
author: Sylvia Plath

quote: I wasn’t insane until someone touched my heart.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: All suffering originates from craving, from attachment, from desire.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: Years of love have been forgot, in the hatred of a minute.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: I grew angry and cursed, with the curse of silence, the river, and the lilies, and the wind, and the forest, and the heaven, and the thunder, and the sighs of the water-lilies.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: I know what I have given you… I do not know what you have received.
author: Antonio Porchia

quote: The trouble with having an open mind, of course, is that people will insist on coming along and trying to put things in it.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: You couldn’t say, ‘I had orders.’ You couldn’t say, ‘It’s not fair.’ No one was listening. There were no words. You owned yourself.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: Always remember that the crowd that applauds your coronation is the same crowd that will applaud your beheading. People like a show.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: Why do you go away? So that you can come back. So that you can see the place you came from with new eyes and extra colors. And the people there see you differently, too. Coming back to where you started is not the same as never leaving.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: Real stupidity beats artificial intelligence every time.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote:
She heard him mutter, ‘Can you take away this grief?’
‘I'm sorry,’ she replied. ‘Everyone asks me. And I would not do so even if I knew how. It belongs to you. Only time and tears take away grief; that is what they are for.’
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: Evil begins when you begin to treat people as things.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: It is said that your life flashes before your eyes just before you die. That is true, it’s called Life.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: Light thinks it travels faster than anything but it is wrong. No matter how fast light travels, it finds the darkness has always got there first, and is waiting for it.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: What have I always believed? That on the whole, and by and large, if a man lived properly, not according to what any priests said, but according to what seemed decent and honest inside, then it would, at the end, more or less, turn out all right.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: It is vital to remember who you really are. It’s very important. It isn’t a good idea to rely on other people or things to do it for you, you see. They always get it wrong.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: You can’t go around building a better world for people. Only people can build a better world for people. Otherwise it’s just a cage.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: It may help to understand human affairs to be clear that most of the great triumphs and tragedies of history are caused, not by people being fundamentally good or fundamentally bad, but by people being fundamentally people.
author: Terry Pratchett and Neil Gaiman

quote: She was beautiful, but she was beautiful in the way a forest fire was beautiful: something to be admired from a distance, not up close.
author: Terry Pratchett and Neil Gaiman

quote: I don’t see why it matters what is written. Not when it’s about people. It can always be crossed out.
author: Terry Pratchett and Neil Gaiman

quote: Love is a reciprocal torture.
author: Marcel Proust
source: In Search of Lost Time / Remembrance of Things Past Vol II: Within a Budding Grove, 1919

quote: Happiness is beneficial for the body, but it is grief that develops the power of the mind.
author: Marcel Proust
source: In Search of Lost Time / Remembrance of Things Past Vol. VII: The Past Recaptured, 1927

quote: You cannot change what you are, only what you do.
author: Philip Pullman

quote: If it weren’t for the tears on your cheeks, I’d say you were a monster like me.
author: H.C.R.

quote: All this time I drank you like the cure, when maybe, you were the poison.
author: Clementine Von Radics

quote: We are not in love. Not the way I’ve been told being in love feels like. But we have been sleeping beside each other for so many nights and I am the most beautiful doormat you have ever walked over.
author: Clementine Von Radics

quote: I found the rooms between the violence of comets. I threw myself into anything’s path. Even the sky bent around me. How lonely to be something that nothing wants to kill.
author: Jeremy Radin
source: So I Locked Myself Inside a Star for Twenty Years

quote: I think, in the poems, we must continually mine what it is we think we can’t say, what it is we think might get us killed. Because it actually might be the thing that keeps us alive, that gives us life. Taking that risk.
author: Roger Reeves

quote:
The day that I lost all feeling
I was both a Fool and a Goddess.
author: Pam Rehm

quote: The sea is a dangerous place because it makes you believe in forever.
author: Beth Revis

quote:
I hate trying to sleep because it’s so silent.
I hate the silence because it makes me think.
I hate thinking because then, I’ll start overthinking.
I hate overthinking because it makes me anxious and nervous.
And I’d end up crying because of the fear.
But I like crying.
Because it exhausts me, and eventually I’ll cry myself to sleep.
And I like sleeping.
Because it feels like dying for a few hours.
author: Lea Reyes

quote: So, do it. Decide. Is this the life you want to live? Is this the person you want to love? Is this the best you can be? Can you be stronger? Kinder? More compassionate? Decide. Breathe in. Breathe out and decide.
author: Shonda Rhimes

quote: The world changes, we do not, therein lies the irony that kills us.
author: Anne Rice

quote: Do you know what it means to have Death know your name?
author: Anne Rice

quote: Don’t bend; don’t water it down; don’t try to make it logical; don’t edit your own soul according to the fashion. Rather, follow your most intense obsessions mercilessly.
author: Anne Rice
source: The Metamorphosis, In the Penal Colony and Other Stories [Forward]

quote:
I want to call this, life.
But I can’t call it life until we start to move
beyond this secret circle of fire
where our bodies are giant shadows flung on a wall
where the night becomes our inner darkness, and sleeps
like a dumb beast, head on her paws, in the corner.
author: Adrienne Rich
source: The Dream of a Common Language, 1978: Origins and History of Consciousness

quote: A thinking woman sleeps with monsters.
author: Adrienne Rich

quote: To write as if your life depended on it: to write across the chalkboard, putting up there in public words you have dredged, sieved up from dreams, from behind screen memories, out of silence — words you have dreaded and needed in order to know you exist.
author: Adrienne Rich
source: What is Found There: Notebooks on Poetry and Politics, 1993: ‘As if Your Life Depended on It’

quote: Our task is to take this earth so deeply and wholly into ourselves that it will resurrect within our being.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke
source: in a letter to Witold Hulewicz

quote: I love the dark hours of my being. My mind deepens into them.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: You needed your whole self: you went and broke yourself, in pieces, out of its control, painfully, out, because you needed yourself.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: The trees you planted in childhood have grown too heavy. You cannot bring them along. Give yourselves to the air, to what you cannot hold.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: And from then on I bathed in the Poem Of the Sea, infused with stars and lactescent, devouring the azure verses;
author: Arthur Rimbaud

quote: A thousand dreams within me softly burn.
author: Arthur Rimbaud

quote: My heart has been stabbed by grace.
author: Arthur Rimbaud

quote: Never forget that softness is strength, unflinching against the knife, and it is also the knife.
author: Jess Rizkallah
source: The Magic My Body Becomes: Poems, ‘Ghada says’

quote: Unhappiness is the ultimate form of self-indulgence.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: The gods do not limit men. Men limit men.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: I don’t want salvation, I want life, all of life, the miserable as well as the superb.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: And it is divine authority, is it not, that insists that we must die? That grants us consciousness for a few decades, then, no matter how gloriously we have used it, snatches it away? Surely the human race committed some heinous atavistic crime for the gods to inflict it with mortality, as they have; and isn’t it a worsening of our crime, a compounding of our guilt, to try to escape our just punishment?
author: Tom Robbins

quote: The universe does not have laws. It has habits. And habits can be broken.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: Maybe it is that I long not for the perfect but for the complete, and there is something incomplete about a life that is dedicated to escape from life.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: The price of self-destiny is never cheap, and in certain situations it is unthinkable. But to achieve the marvelous, it is precisely the unthinkable that must be thought.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: If you lack the iron and fizz to take control of your own life, if you insist on leaving your fate to the gods, then the gods will repay your weakness by having a grin or two at your expense.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: A sense of humor, properly developed, is superior to any religion so far devised.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: Perhaps the most terrible thing that can happen to an imaginative youth, aside from the curse of imagination itself, is to be exposed without preparation to the life outside his or her own sphere — the sudden revelation that there is a there out there.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: To eliminate the agitation and disappointment of desire, we need but awaken to the fact that we have everything we want and need right now.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: Our individuality is all, all, that we have. There are those who barter it for security, those who repress it for what they believe is the betterment of the whole society, but blessed in the twinkle of the morning star is the one who nurtures it and rides it, in grace and love and wit, from peculiar station to peculiar station along life’s bittersweet route.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: She needed help, but God was in a meeting whenever she rang.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: Birth and death were easy. It was life that was hard.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: There is a comfort in conformity, a security in control, that is appealing. There is a thrill in domination, and we are all of us secretly attracted to violence.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: The immortals are gone. Now we are the immortals.
author: Tom Robbins

quote: If you could only sense how important you are to the lives of those you meet; how important you can be to the people you may never even dream of. There is something of yourself that you leave at every meeting with another person.
author: Fred Rogers
source: as cited in The World According to Mister Rogers: Important Things to Remember, 2004

quote: I know you’ll never love me, but maybe you’ll stay for a little while.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: Since I was young, I have always known this: life damages us, every one. We can’t escape that damage. But now, I am also learning this: we can be mended. We mend each other.
author: Veronica Roth

quote: I just want to break that song into pieces and love them all to death.
author: Rainbow Rowell

quote: If you’re happy in a dream… does that count? The happiness – does it count?
author: Arundhati Roy

quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
author: Rumi
source: as cited in The Essential Rumi, 1995, translated by Coleman Barks

quote: Stop acting so small. You are the universe in ecstatic motion.
author: Rumi
source: as cited in The Essential Rumi, 1995, translated by Coleman Barks

quote: But listen to me: for one moment, quit being sad. Hear blessings dropping their blossoms around you.
author: Rumi
source: as cited in The Essential Rumi, 1995, translated by Coleman Barks

quote: Sleep. Those little slices of death. How I loathe them.
author: Chuck Russel
source: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors, 1987 (misattributed to Edgar Allan Poe)

quote: I think too much. I think ahead. I think behind. I think sideways. I think it all. If it exists, I’ve fucking thought of it.
author: Winona Ryder

quote: The problem with my life was that it was someone else’s idea.
author: Benjamin Alire Saenz
source: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe

quote: The universe is a pretty big place. If it’s just us, seems like an awful waste of space.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: The sky calls to us. If we do not destroy ourselves, we will one day venture to the stars.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: Imagination will often carry us to worlds that never were, but without it we go nowhere.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: Every star may be a sun to someone.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: We might get away with it for a while, but sooner or later this combustible mixture of ignorance and power is going to blow up in our faces.
author: Carl Sagan
source: The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

quote: After the earth dies, some 5 billion years from now, after it’s burned to a crisp, or even swallowed by the Sun, there will be other worlds and stars and galaxies coming into being – and they will know nothing of a place once called Earth.
author: Carl Sagan

quote: It is only with one’s heart that one can see clearly. What is essential is invisible to the eye.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

quote: I had this feeling suddenly. I get this feeling a lot, but I don’t know if there’s one word for it. It’s not nervous or sad or even lonely. It’s all of that, and then a bit more.
author: Leila Sales

quote: The feeling is I don’t belong here. I don’t know how I got here, and I don’t know how long I can stay before everyone else realizes that I am an imposter. I am a fraud.
author: Leila Sales

quote: I’ve gotten this feeling nearly everywhere I have ever been in my life. There’s nothing you can do about it except drink some water and hope that it subsides. Or you can leave.
author: Leila Sales

quote: I was about half in love with her by the time we sat down. That’s the thing about girls. Every time they do something pretty… you fall half in love with them, and then you never know where the hell you are. Girls. Jesus Christ. They can drive you crazy. They really can.
author: J.D. Salinger

quote: If all insects on Earth disappeared, within 50 years all life on Earth would end. If all human beings disappeared from the Earth, within 50 years all forms of life would flourish.
author: Jonas Salk

quote: There are books in which the footnotes or comments scrawled by some reader’s hand in the margin are more interesting than the text. The world is one of these books.
author: George Santayana

quote:
their heart grew cold
they let their wings down.
author: Sappho

quote:
for the man who is beautiful is beautiful to see
but the good man will at once also beautiful be.
author: Sappho

quote:
not one girl I think
who looks on the light of the sun
will ever
have wisdom
like this.
author: Sappho

quote: In the crooks of your body, I find my religion.
author: Sappho

quote:
but I am not someone who likes to wound
rather I have a quiet mind.
author: Sappho

quote:
someone will remember us
I say
even in another time.
author: Sappho

quote:
wealth without virtue is no harmless neighbor
but a mixture of both attains the height of happiness.
author: Sappho

quote: I do not know what makes a writer, but it probably isn’t happiness.
author: William Saroyan

quote: It’s strange. I felt less lonely when I didn’t know you.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: Every word has consequences. Every silence, too.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: As for me, I am mean: that means that I need the suffering of others to exist. A flame. A flame in their hearts. When I am all alone, I am extinguished.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: Ha! to forget. How childish! I feel you in my bones. Your silence screams in my ears. You may nail your mouth shut, you may cut out your tongue, but can you keep yourself from existing? Can you stop your thoughts?
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: One always dies too soon — or too late. And yet, life is there, finished: the line is drawn, and it must all be added up. You are nothing other than your life.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: I will take it all: tongs, molten lead, prongs, garrotes, all that burns, all that tears, I want to truly suffer. Better one hundred bites, better the whip, vitriol, than this suffering in the head, this ghost of suffering which grazes and caresses and never hurts enough.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: Don’t you feel the same way? When I cannot see myself, even though I touch myself, I wonder if I really exist.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: So that is what hell is. I would never have believed it. You remember: the fire and brimstone, the torture. Ah! the farce. There is no need for torture: Hell is other people.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quote: We can only feel sorry for ourselves when our misfortunes are still supportable. Once this limit is crossed, the only way to bear the unbearable is to laugh at it.
author: Marjane Satrapi

quote: Once again, I arrived at my usual conclusion: One must educate oneself.
author: Marjane Satrapi

quote: Have you ever sat in complete darkness with someone? Somehow the words feel heavier and the phrases deeper, and all of a sudden the room is no longer just in darkness but quietly lit with the light of their soul. You can see it bare. Without it’s shell. Defenseless. There’s too much the light hides.
author: Jenn Satsune

quote: Quite an experience to live in fear, isn’t it? That’s what it is to be a slave.
author: Ridley Scott

quote: Read a thousand books, and your words will flow like a river.
author: Lisa See

quote:
Everyone is asleep
There is nothing to come between
The moon and me.
author: Enomoto Seifu-jo

quote:
A woman who writes feels too much…
She thinks she can warn the stars.
A writer is essentially a spy.
Dear love, I️ am that girl.
author: Anne Sexton

quote: I am torn in two but I will conquer myself.
author: Anne Sexton

quote: I feel unspeakably lonely. And I feel — drained. It is a blank state of mind and soul I cannot describe to you as I think it would not make any difference. Also it is a very private feeling I have — that of melting into a perpetual nervous breakdown. I am often questioning myself what I further want to do, who I further wish to be; which parts of me, exactly, are still functioning properly. No answers, darling. At all.
author: Anne Sexton

quote: Hell is empty, and all the devils are here.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Don’t live the same year 75 times and call it a life.
author: Robin Sharma

quote: My dear: in this world there is always danger for those who are afraid of it.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: I am unstable, sometimes melancholy, and have been called on some occasions imperious; but I never did an ungenerous act in my life. I sympathise warmly with others, and have wasted my heart in their love and service.
author: Mary Shelley

quote: My dreams were all my own; I accounted for them to nobody; they were my refuge when annoyed — my dearest pleasure when free.
author: Mary Shelley

quote: Somebody asked me if I was looking for something. I am looking for everything.
author: Sam Sheridan
source: A Fighter's Heart: One Man's Journey Through the World of Fighting, 2008

quote: Even if I now saw you, only once, I would long for you through worlds. Worlds.
author: Izumi Shikibu
source: as cited in The Ink Dark Moon: Love Poems, 1990, translated by Jane Hirshfield

quote: I cannot wait for the stars to align any longer. It is time to paint my own cosmos.
author: Noor Shirazie

quote: I’m sorry you were not truly loved and that it made you cruel.
author: Warsan Shire

quote: My alone feels so good, I’ll only have you if you’re sweeter than my solitude.
author: Warsan Shire

quote: Not everyone is okay with living like an open wound. But the thing about open wounds is that, well, you aren’t ignoring it, you’re healing. The fresh air can get to it. It’s honest. You aren’t hiding who you are. You aren’t rotting. People can give you advice on how to heal without scarring badly.
author: Warsan Shire

quote:
Mother says there are locked rooms inside all women; kitchen of lust,
bedroom of grief, bathroom of apathy.
Sometimes the men - they come with keys,
and sometimes, the men - they come with hammers.
author: Warsan Shire

quote: I am a lover without a lover. I am lovely and lonely and I belong deeply to myself.
author: Warsan Shire
source: ‘Thirty Four Excuses for Why We Failed at Love’

quote: The beginning is the end, and the end is the beginning. Well then, let us begin again. And to each, their own tale.
author: Kyou Shirodaira

quote: I see now that the circumstances of one’s birth are irrelevant; it is what you do with the gift of life that determines who you are.
author: Takeshi Shudo
source: dir. Pokémon: The First Movie: Mewtwo Strikes Back, 1998

quote: A sword is a tool designed to inflict pain or death on a fellow human. Often spiritualised and glorified, they also serve as a physical metaphor for humanity’s eternal, savage thirst for destruction!
author: Tom Siddell

quote: I continue to turn my face upwards, measuring the same temperature, the same humidity, radiation, and thousands of other variables. But now a new metric has been added. The number of angels I have seen is ‘one’. And I will keep watch for more.
author: Tom Siddell

quote: You are stronger than you were this morning. Even if it does not feel that way. And you will become stronger still. Strong enough to walk on your own. Show them you are not afraid.
author: Tom Siddell

quote:
To the ones that have not loved you like you deserve,
may you forget their names.
May you remember your own, always.
author: Caitlyn Siehl

quote: If you walk into a room and notice what is missing from it, it’s still there, isn’t it?
author: Caitlyn Siehl

quote: Eventually something you love is going to be taken away. And then you will fall to the floor crying. And then, however much later, it is finally happening to you: you’re falling to the floor crying thinking, ’I am falling to the floor crying,’ but there’s an element of the ridiculous to it — you knew it would happen and, even worse, while you’re on the floor crying you look at the place where the wall meets the floor and you realize you didn’t paint it very well.
author: Richard Siken

quote: Wanna make a monster? Take the parts of yourself that make you uncomfortable — your weaknesses, bad thoughts, vanities, and hungers — and pretend they’re across the room. It’s too ugly to be human. It’s too ugly to be you. Children are afraid of the dark because they have nothing real to work with. Adults are afraid of themselves.
author: Richard Siken

quote: If the dead are watching, I want them to see us writing, dancing, singing, painting. I want them to see that we still reach out to each other.
author: Richard Siken

quote: I couldn’t get the boy to kill me, but I wore his jacket for the longest time.
author: Richard Siken

quote: You're going to die in your best friend's arms. And you play along because it's funny, because it's written down, you've memorized it, it's all you know. I say the phrases that keep it all going, and everybody plays along. Imagine: Someone's pulling a gun, and you're jumping into the middle of it. You didn't think you'd feel this way.
author: Richard Siken

quote: Hold onto your voice. Hold onto your breath. Don’t make a noise, don’t leave the room until I come back from the dead for you. I will come back from the dead for you.
author: Richard Siken

quote: How much can you change and get away with it, before you turn into someone else, before it’s some kind of murder?
author: Richard Siken
source: War of the Foxes, ‘Portrait of Fryderyk in Shifting Light’

quote: At times the world can seem an unfriendly and sinister place, but believe us when we say there is much more good in it than bad. All you have to do is look hard enough. And what might seem to be a series of unfortunate events, may, in fact, be the first steps of a journey.
author: Brad Silberling
source: dir. Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events, 2004

quote: They say opposites attract. So I guess I’m stuck with you. I still haven’t decided if this is a blessing or a curse. All I know is that you are my heaven and my hell… And somehow I find myself both loving and hating you for it.
author: Lynette Simeone

quote: People change and life moves on; what a beautifully terrifying thought.
author: Lynette Simeone

quote: I think some people are just inexplicably bonded. Drawn by forces beyond their own comprehension, they have no choice but to gravitate toward one another. Destined by fate to keep crossing paths until they finally get it right.
author: L.B. Simmons

quote: What kept me sane was knowing that things would change, and it was a question of keeping myself together until they did.
author: Nina Simone
source: I Put a Spell on You: The Autobiography of Nina Simone, 1992

quote: I think our experience of the universe has value. Even if it disappears forever.
author: Jonathan Sims

quote: As the image of myself becomes sharper in my brain & more precious, I feel less afraid that someone else will erase me by denying me love.
author: Jenny Slate

quote: I recommend learning how to write a very good thank you note. A child who can write a nice thank you note can turn into a cocaine dealer five years later and be remembered as the child who wrote nice thank you notes.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: The sea is nothing but a library of all the tears in history.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: If we wait until we’re ready, we’ll be waiting the rest of our lives.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: There are times to stay put, and what you want will come to you, and there are times to go out into the world and find such a thing for yourself.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: One of the remarkable things about love is that, despite very irritating people writing poems and songs about how pleasant it is, it really is quite pleasant.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: It is so rare in this world to meet a trustworthy person who truly wants to help you, and finding such a person can make you feel warm and safe, even if you are in the middle of a windy valley high up in the mountains.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: The sad truth is, the truth is sad.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: Do the scary thing first, and get scared later.
author: Lemony Snicket

quote: Knowing that something is wrong and doing it anyway happens very often in life, and I doubt I will ever know why.
author: Lemony Snicket
source: Who Could That Be at This Hour?

quote: Do I live in a dream on another planet?
author: Edith Södergran

quote: Archaeologists have yet to discover an early stage of human existence when we possessed no art. In the twilight preceding the dawn of mankind we received it from hands which we did not have a chance to see clearly. Neither had we time to ask: Why this gift for us? How should we treat it?
author: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

quote: All those prognosticators of the decay, degeneration, and death of art were wrong and will always be wrong. It shall be we who die; art will remain. And shall we even comprehend before our passing all of its aspects and the entirety of its purposes?
author: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

quote: I vulgarize my feelings by speaking of them too readily to others.
author: Susan Sontag

quote: A thought occurred to me today – so obvious, so always obvious! It was absurd to suddenly comprehend it for the first time – I felt rather giddy, a little hysterical: – There is nothing, nothing that stops me from doing anything except myself… What is to prevent me from just picking up and taking off?
author: Susan Sontag

quote: How far from the beginning are we? When did we first start to feel the wound?
author: Susan Sontag

quote: Always this feeling of being ‘too much’ for them — a creature from another planet — so I would try to scale myself down to size, so that I could be apprehendable by (lovable by) them.
author: Susan Sontag

quote: Do you ever wonder why things have to turn out the way they do?
author: Nicholas Sparks

quote: I have striven not to laugh at human actions, not to weep at them, nor to hate them, but to understand them.
author: Baruch Spinoza

quote: It is an easy mistake to think that non-talkers are non-feelers.
author: Wallace Stegner

quote: And now that you don’t have to be perfect, you can be good.
author: John Steinbeck

quote: I pray anyway: how beautiful, the hawks circling the inner rim of loss.
author: Melissa Studdard

quote: The world is created with sound. And it will probably end in silence. So until then, I say keep dancing and singing and laughing.
author: Sufjan Stevens
source: at the Saenger Theatre in New Orleans: May 9, 2015

quote: You go on by doing the best you can. You go on by being generous. You go on by being true. You go on by offering comfort to others who can't go on. You go on by allowing the unbearable days to pass and allowing the pleasure in other days. You go on by finding a channel for your love and another for your rage.
author: Cherlyn Strayed
source: Tiny Beautiful Things: Advice on Love and Life from Dear Sugar, 2012

quote:
From too much love of living,
From hope and fear set free,
We thank with brief thanksgiving
Whatever gods may be
That no life lives for ever;
That dead men rise up never;
That even the weariest river
Winds somewhere safe to sea.
author: A.C. Swinburne

quote: Mama said, ‘you are a girl’ and no I told her, I am not. I am a verb. A noun does not own me. I am a boundless motion: the revolt.
author: Valerie T.

quote:
What do you want to tell me? the woman asks.
The snake pauses.
Nothing, he says. You are a poet. You will find it all out
soon enough.
author: Kira Tang

quote: There are a few things in life so beautiful they hurt: swimming in the ocean while it rains, reading alone in empty libraries, the sea of stars that appear when you’re miles away from the neon lights of the city, bars after 2am, walking in the wilderness, all the phases of the moon, the things we do not know about the universe, and you.
author: Beau Taplin

quote:
One day, whether you
are 14, 28, or 65
you will stumble upon
someone who will start
a fire in you that cannot die.
However, the saddest,
most awful truth
you will ever come to find —
is they are not always
with whom we spend our lives.
author: Beau Taplin
source: Worlds of You: Poetry & Prose, ‘The Awful Truth’

quote: In a certain sense the past is far more real, or at any rate more stable, more resilient than the present. The present slips and vanishes like sand between the fingers, acquiring material weight, only in its recollection.
author: Andrei Tarkovsky
source: Sculpting in Time: Reflections on the Cinema

quote: A great sorrow, and one that I am only beginning to understand: we don’t get to choose our own hearts. We can’t make ourselves want what’s good for us or what’s good for other people. We don’t get to choose the people we are.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: You can look at a picture for a week and never think of it again. You can also look at a picture for a second and think of it all your life.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: Because, here’s the truth: life is catastrophe.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: Stay away from the ones you love too much. Those are the ones who will kill you.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: I am nothing in my soul if not obsessive.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: And I know I said earlier that he was perfect but he wasn’t perfect, far from it; he could be silly and vain and remote and often cruel and still we loved him, in spite of, because.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: It is better to know one book intimately than a hundred superficially.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: I liked the idea of living in a city — any city, especially a strange one — liked the thought of traffic and crowds, of working in a bookstore, waiting tables in a coffee shop, who knew what kind of odd, solitary life I might slip into? Meals alone, walking the dogs in the evenings; and nobody knowing who I was.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: It is a terrible thing to learn as a child that one is a being separate from all the world, that no one and no thing hurts along with one’s burned tongues and skinned knees, that one’s aches and pains are all one’s own. Even more terrible, as we grow older, to learn that no person, no matter how beloved, can ever truly understand us. Our own selves make us most unhappy, and that’s why we’re so anxious to lose them, don’t you think?
author: Donna Tartt

quote: Beauty is rarely soft or consolatory. Quite the contrary. Genuine beauty is always quite alarming.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: If we are strong enough in our souls we can rip away the veil and look that naked, terrible beauty right in the face; let God consume us, devour us, unstring our bones. Then spit us out reborn.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: I looked at him. There was so much I wanted to ask him, so much I wanted to say; but somehow I knew there wasn’t time and even if there was, that it was all, somehow, beside the point.
author: Donna Tartt

quote: I understand that nobody understands me, but I can’t be someone I’m not.
author: Audrey Tautou

quote: Do not depend too much on anyone in this world, because even your shadow leaves you when you are in darkness.
author: Ibn Taymiyyah

quote: Then when G-d asks [Cain], ‘Where is your brother Abel?’ he arrogantly responds, ‘I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?’ In essence, the entire Bible is written as an affirmative response to this question.
author: Rabbi Joseph Telushkin

quote: I want to stop writing about fire, but I trust I will not.
author: Terrell Jamal Terry

quote: I still love the people I’ve loved, even if I cross the street to avoid them.
author: Uma Thurman

quote: I know there was something before you. I just can’t remember what it was.
author: Iain Thomas
source: I Wrote This for You, ‘The Forgotten Feeling’

quote: There are some people you’ll never see again. At least, not in the same way.
author: Iain Thomas
source: I Wrote This for You: Just the Words

quote: I love you not as something private and personal, which is my own, but as something universal and worthy of love, which I have found.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: There’s some good on this world — and it’s worth fighting for.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

quote: You are the universe, expressing itself as human for a little while.
author: Eckhart Tolle
source: A New Earth: Awakening Your Life's Purpose

quote: I hope you find love, but more importantly I hope you’re strong enough to walk away from what love isn’t.
author: Tiffany Tomiko

quote: I think love is the greatest force in the universe. It’s shapeless like water. It only takes the shape of things it becomes.
author: Guillermo del Toro

quote: But who prays for Satan? Who, in eighteen centuries, has had the common humanity to pray for the one sinner that needed it most?
author: Mark Twain

quote: The universe is under no obligation to make sense to you.
author: Neil DeGrasse Tyson

quote: When the people of the world all know beauty as beauty, there arises the recognition of ugliness. When they all know good as good, there arises the recognition of evil.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: New beginnings are often disguised as painful endings.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Not seeking, not expecting, she is present, and can welcome all things.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Because she competes with no one, no one can compete with her.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
author: Lao Tzu

quote:
1. You must let the pain visit.
2. You must allow it teach you.
3. You must not allow it overstay.
author: Ijeoma Umebinyuo

quote: I love the rain. I love how it softens the outlines of things. The world becomes softly blurred, and I feel like I melt right into it.
author: Chica Umino

quote: The more stubborn people become and insist that they’re right, the further away happiness gets.
author: Gen Urobuchi

quote: Don’t forget. Always, somewhere, someone is fighting for you. As long as you remember her, you are not alone.
author: Gen Urobuchi

quote:
I called out your name three times,
only to look back,
Revelation, revelation:
until the day you stopped running after me.
author: Barbara Valentina
source: Letters I Mailed to the Bottom of the River

quote:
Isn’t all that rage so ugly?
And isn’t it mine, still?
Good god, isn’t it mine?
author: Ashe Vernon

quote:
Don’t you dare, for one minute,
believe that my kindness makes me
anything but insurmountable.
I did not unzip my chest to every kind of hurt,
and stagger back, wounded and alive,
just to hear you call me weak for trying.
author: Ashe Vernon

quote:
I left home and took the fall of Troy with me.
My bones took up arms at the battle of Thermopylae.
I was Artemis. I was Ares.
And the warfare in my blood
does not end in silence.
Olympus falls, but the temples
go on beating,
and I am the patron saint of my own survival,
and I have sacrificed everything
except my own heartbeat.
author: Ashe Vernon

quote: My notebooks. So sadly full, this one with impotence, the other with empty, pointless waiting. The most difficult of waits, the most painful: the wait for oneself. If I were to write something in it, it would be the confession that I too have been waiting for myself for a long time, and I haven’t turned up.
author: Josefina Vicens

quote: Everything you say should be true, but not everything true should be said.
author: Voltaire

quote: May God defend me from my friends: I can defend myself from my enemies.
author: Voltaire

quote: The more I read, the more I acquire, the more certain I am that I know nothing.
author: Voltaire

quote: I’ve wanted to kill myself a hundred times, but somehow I am still in love with life.
author: Voltaire

quote: We’re neither pure, nor wise, nor good; we do the best we know.
author: Voltaire

quote: Alas! it was love; love, the comfort of the human species; love, the preserver of the universe; the soul of all sensible beings; love! tender love!
author: Voltaire

quote: If there were no God, it would have been necessary to invent him.
author: Voltaire
source: Épître à l'Auteur du Livre des Trois Imposteurs

quote: One owes respect to the living: To the dead one owes only the truth.
author: Voltaire

quote: I still catch myself feeling blue about things that don’t matter anymore.
author: Kurt Vonnegut

quote:
‘So when people I like do something terrible,’ I said, ‘I just flense them and forgive them.’
‘Flense?’ he said. ‘What’s flense?’
‘It’s what whalers used to do to whale carcasses when they got them on board,’ I said. ‘They would strip off the skin and blubber and meat right down to the skeleton. I do that in my head to people — get rid of all the meat so I can see nothing but their souls. Then I forgive them.’
author: Kurt Vonnegut

quote:
Say surrender. Say alabaster. Switchblade.
Honeysuckle. Goldenrod. Say autumn.
Say autumn despite the green
in your eyes. Beauty despite
daylight. Say you’d kill for it. Unbreakable dawn
mounting in your throat.
My thrashing beneath you
like a sparrow stunned
with falling.
author: Ocean Vuong

quote: Don’t we touch each other just to prove we are still here?
author: Ocean Vuong

quote: The most beautiful part of your body is where it's headed. & remember, loneliness is still time spent with the world.
author: Ocean Vuong

quote:
Suppose you do change your life.
& the body is more than
a portion of night — sealed
with bruises. Suppose you woke
& found your shadow replaced
by a black wolf. The boy, beautiful
& gone. So you take the knife to the wall
instead. You carve & carve
until a coin of light appears
& you get to look in, at last,
on happiness. The eye
staring back from the other side —
waiting.
author: Ocean Vuong

quote: I think, from all I can learn, that heaven has the better climate, but hell has the better company.
author: Benjamin Wade
source: as cited by Arthur MacArthur in Proceedings of the National Conference of Charities and Correction, at the Twelfth Annual Session Held in Washington, D.C., June 4-10, 1885, 1885

quote: Not only do I not have a very firm grasp on reality, but I have sort of a loose grip on my fantasies, too.
author: Jane Wagner
source: The Search for Signs of Intelligent Life in the Universe

quote: When you meet that person. A person. One of your soulmates. Let the connection, relationship be what it is. It may be five minutes. Five hours. Five days. Five months. Five years. A lifetime. Let it manifest itself, the way it is meant to. It has an organic destiny. This way if it stays or if it leaves, you will be softer from having been loved this authentically. Souls come into, return, open, and sweep through your life for a myriad of reasons, let them be who and what they are meant to be.
author: Nayyirah Waheed

quote: I took what used to be my hand and let it rest on what used to be my stomach. Imagine you are nothing. I did not have to imagine.
author: Claire Wahmanholm

quote: This is an apology letter to the both of us for how long it took me to let things go. It was not my intention to make such a production of the emptiness between us.
author: Buddy Wakefield

quote: How odd, I can have all this inside me, and to you it’s just words.
author: David Foster Wallace

quote: Sometimes I feel the past and the future pressing so hard on either side that there’s no room for the present.
author: Evelyn Waugh

quote: Oh how wrong we were to think that immortality meant never dying.
author: Gerard Way

quote: I kneel into a dream where I am good & loved. I am good. I am loved. My hands have made some good mistakes. They can always make better ones.
author: Natalie Wee
source: Our Bodies & Other Fine Machines, 2016: ‘Least of All’

quote: How can I make this problem my ally?
author: Susun S. Weed

quote: In Greek, ‘nostalgia’ literally means ‘the pain from an old wound.’ It’s a twinge in your heart, far more powerful than memory alone. This device isn’t a spaceship, it’s a time machine. It goes backwards and forwards, it takes us to a place where we ache to go again.
author: Matthew Weiner

quote: Sometimes, you have to step outside of the person you’ve been and remember the person you were meant to be. The person you want to be. The person you are.
author: H.G. Wells

quote: I’m addicted to silence and privacy; I wallow in it.
author: Valorie Wesley

quote: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough.
author: Mae West

quote: Did you ever notice how in the Bible, whenever God needed to punish someone, or make an example, or whenever God needed a killing, he sent an angel? Did you ever wonder what a creature like that must be like? A whole existence spent praising your God, but always with one wing dipped in blood. Would you ever really want to see an angel?
author: Gregory Widen

quote: The heart was made to be broken.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Yes: I am a dreamer. For a dreamer is one who can only find his way by moonlight, and his punishment is that he sees the dawn before the rest of the world.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Most people are other people. Their thoughts are someone else’s opinions, their lives a mimicry, their passions a quotation.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: I don’t want to go to heaven. None of my friends are there.
author: Oscar Wilde
source: Lord Arthur Savile's Crime and Other Stories

quote: The books that the world calls immoral are books that show the world its own shame.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: ‘What are you?’ ‘To define is to limit.’
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: With freedom, books, flowers, and the moon, who could not be happy?
author: Oscar Wilde
source: The Soul of Man, and Prison Writings

quote: In all these years, you never believed I loved you. And I did. I did so much. I did love you. I even loved your hate and your hardness.
author: Tennessee Williams

quote: Because your sighs have fermented my blood, I need no wine.
author: Lawrence Winkler

quote: She wishes she could treat pain like a coin purse — something spare, sparse, to be exchanged for something else.
author: Emily Paige Wilson
source: Hypochondria, Least Powerful of the Greek Gods, pts ii & iv

quote: Ask any woman & she’ll tell you why Eve bit into that apple. Why she chose the universe instead of you.
author: Topaz Winters

quote:
‘Do you fall in love often?’
Yes, often. With a view, with a book, with a dog, a cat, with numbers, with friends, with complete strangers, with nothing at all.
author: Jeanette Winterson

quote: The curious are always in some danger. If you are curious you might never come home, like all the men who now live with mermaids at the bottom of the sea.
author: Jeanette Winterson

quote: ‘You’ll get over it…’ It’s the clichés that cause the trouble. To lose someone you love is to alter your life for ever. You don’t get over it because ‘it’ is the person you loved. The pain stops, there are new people, but the gap never closes. How could it? The particularness of someone who mattered enough to grieve over is not made anodyne by death. This hole in my heart is in the shape of you and no-one else can fit it. Why would I want them to?
author: Jeanette Winterson

quote: I’m drawn to the peace in feeling nothing, but I’m also afraid of feeling nothing.
author: Chelsea Wolfe

quote: It’s not about the words. It’s about the memories lost inside the words.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: No need to hurry. No need to sparkle. No need to be anybody but oneself.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: How many times have people used a pen or paintbrush because they couldn’t pull the trigger?
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: Books are everywhere; and always the same sense of adventure fills us. Second-hand books are wild books, homeless books; they have come together in vast flocks of variegated feather, and have a charm which the domesticated volumes of the library lack. Besides, in this random miscellaneous company we may rub against some complete stranger who will, with luck, turn into the best friend we have in the world.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: I am made and remade continually.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: I am not here. I have no face. Other people have faces. Their world is the real world. The things they lift are heavy. They say yes, they say no, whereas I shift and change and am seen through in a second. They know what to say if spoken to. They laugh really; they get angry really; while I have to look first and do whatever other people do when they have done it.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: Happiness is in the quiet, ordinary things. A table, a chair, a book with a paper-knife stuck between the pages. And the petal falling from the rose, and the light flickering as we sit silent.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: I am never stagnant; I rise from my worst disasters, I turn, I change.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: I'm a ghost that everyone can see.
author: Franz Wright

quote: That’s the thing about depression: A human being can survive almost anything, as long as she sees the end in sight. But depression is so insidious, and it compounds daily, that it’s impossible to ever see the end. The fog is like a cage without a key.
author: Elizabeth Wurtzel

quote: I prefer winter and fall, when you feel the bone structure of the landscape — the loneliness of it, the dead feeling of winter. Something waits beneath it, the whole story doesn’t show.
author: Andrew Wyeth
source: ‘I've Actually Created My Own Little World’

quote: I’ve grown lean from eating only the past.
author: Jenny Xie

quote: Dirty, stained, withered, broken things seem beautiful to me.
author: Yohji Yamamoto

quote:
Rock bottom is everything they say it is.
Like heaven or hell, it is not a place,
but a language you cannot understand
until you have nothing.
author: Lauren Yates

quote: The world is full of magic things, patiently waiting for our senses to grow sharper.
author: W.B. Yeats

quote: There’s a Japanese phrase that I like: koi no yokan. It doesn’t mean love at first sight. It’s closer to love at second sight. It’s the feeling when you meet someone that you’re going to fall in love with them. Maybe you don’t love them right away, but it’s inevitable that you will.
author: Nicola Yoon

quote: Look for the unimaginable inside the ordinary. Go to places you would not ordinarily go alone — riverbanks. Deep woods. The part of the ocean shore where peoples’ gazes disappear. Wade in all waters. Let your imagination change what you know.
author: Lidia Yukanavitch

quote:
The wolf runs.
It runs three legged, like all damaged creatures, across the snow.
She thinks: this is true.
She thinks: this is a life.
She thinks: I do not want to die, but my life will always be like this — wounded and animal, lurching against white.
author: Lidia Yuknavitch

quote: If you can spend a perfectly useless afternoon in a perfectly useless manner, you have learned how to live.
author: Lin Yutang

quote: Only once in your life, I truly believe, you find someone who can completely turn your world around. You tell them things that you’ve never shared with another soul and they absorb everything you say and actually want to hear more. You share hopes for the future, dreams that will never come true, goals that were never achieved and the many disappointments life has thrown at you. When something wonderful happens, you can’t wait to tell them about it, knowing they will share in your excitement. They are not embarrassed to cry with you when you are hurting or laugh with you when you make a fool of yourself. Never do they hurt your feelings or make you feel like you are not good enough, but rather they build you up and show you the things about yourself that make you special and even beautiful. There is never any pressure, jealousy or competition but only a quiet calmness when they are around. You can be yourself and not worry about what they will think of you because they love you for who you are. The things that seem insignificant to most people such as a note, song or walk become invaluable treasures kept safe in your heart to cherish forever. Memories of your childhood come back and are so clear and vivid it’s like being young again. Colours seem brighter and more brilliant. Laughter seems part of daily life where before it was infrequent or didn’t exist at all. A phone call or two during the day helps to get you through a long day’s work and always brings a smile to your face. In their presence, there’s no need for continuous conversation, but you find you’re quite content in just having them nearby. Things that never interested you before become fascinating because you know they are important to this person who is so special to you. You think of this person on every occasion and in everything you do. Simple things bring them to mind like a pale blue sky, gentle wind or even a storm cloud on the horizon. You open your heart knowing that there’s a chance it may be broken one day and in opening your heart, you experience a love and joy that you never dreamed possible. You find that being vulnerable is the only way to allow your heart to feel true pleasure that’s so real it scares you. You find strength in knowing you have a true friend and possibly a soul mate who will remain loyal to the end. Life seems completely different, exciting and worthwhile. Your only hope and security is in knowing that they are a part of your life.

quote: You should date a girl who reads.Date a girl who reads. Date a girl who spends her money on books instead of clothes, who has problems with closet space because she has too many books. Date a girl who has a list of books she wants to read, who has had a library card since she was twelve.Find a girl who reads. You’ll know that she does because she will always have an unread book in her bag. She’s the one lovingly looking over the shelves in the bookstore, the one who quietly cries out when she has found the book she wants. You see that weird chick sniffing the pages of an old book in a secondhand book shop? That’s the reader. They can never resist smelling the pages, especially when they are yellow and worn.She’s the girl reading while waiting in that coffee shop down the street. If you take a peek at her mug, the non-dairy creamer is floating on top because she’s kind of engrossed already. Lost in a world of the author’s making. Sit down. She might give you a glare, as most girls who read do not like to be interrupted. Ask her if she likes the book.Buy her another cup of coffee.Let her know what you really think of Murakami. See if she got through the first chapter of Fellowship. Understand that if she says she understood James Joyce’s Ulysses she’s just saying that to sound intelligent. Ask her if she loves Alice or she would like to be Alice.It’s easy to date a girl who reads. Give her books for her birthday, for Christmas, for anniversaries. Give her the gift of words, in poetry and in song. Give her Neruda, Pound, Sexton, Cummings. Let her know that you understand that words are love. Understand that she knows the difference between books and reality but by god, she’s going to try to make her life a little like her favorite book. It will never be your fault if she does.She has to give it a shot somehow.Lie to her. If she understands syntax, she will understand your need to lie. Behind words are other things: motivation, value, nuance, dialogue. It will not be the end of the world.Fail her. Because a girl who reads knows that failure always leads up to the climax. Because girls who read understand that all things must come to end, but that you can always write a sequel. That you can begin again and again and still be the hero. That life is meant to have a villain or two.Why be frightened of everything that you are not? Girls who read understand that people, like characters, develop. Except in the Twilight series.If you find a girl who reads, keep her close. When you find her up at 2 AM clutching a book to her chest and weeping, make her a cup of tea and hold her. You may lose her for a couple of hours but she will always come back to you. She’ll talk as if the characters in the book are real, because for a while, they always are.You will propose on a hot air balloon. Or during a rock concert. Or very casually next time she’s sick. Over Skype.You will smile so hard you will wonder why your heart hasn’t burst and bled out all over your chest yet. You will write the story of your lives, have kids with strange names and even stranger tastes. She will introduce your children to the Cat in the Hat and Aslan, maybe in the same day. You will walk the winters of your old age together and she will recite Keats under her breath while you shake the snow off your boots.Date a girl who reads because you deserve it. You deserve a girl who can give you the most colorful life imaginable. If you can only give her monotony, and stale hours and half-baked proposals, then you’re better off alone. If you want the world and the worlds beyond it, date a girl who reads.Or better yet, date a girl who writes.

quote: I saw my life branching out before me like the green fig tree in the story. From the tip of every branch, like a fat purple fig, a wonderful future beckoned and winked. I saw myself sitting in the crotch of this fig tree, starving to death, just because I couldn't make up my mind which of the figs I would choose. I wanted each and every one of them, but choosing one meant losing all the rest, and, as I sat there, unable to decide, the figs began to wrinkle and go black, and, one by one, they plopped to the ground at my feet.

Oh, I kept the first for another day! Yet knowing how way leads on to way, I doubted if I should ever come back. I shall be telling this with a sigh Somewhere ages and ages hence: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I— I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
